title: Static Ads Specialist (Meta, multi-market DTC)
description:
About the role

We are looking for a Static Ads Specialist who produces 15 to 20 Meta image ads per week across several European markets, and who d
 what to make, not just how to make it. This is a remote, long-term contractor role for a multi-brand DTC group running 10+ Shopify stores (cookware, supplements, apparel, pet, footwear) with Meta ads as the main acquisition channel and 500+ orders per day.



Most people can produce a clean static ad today. What we cannot buy off the shelf is marketing sense: knowing which angle, hook, format and visual language will stop a German, Swedish or Dutch scroller, and why. That judgment is the job. The tools are secondary.



What you will do



You own static ad production for our European stores, from angle to export-ready file.

• Deliver 3 to 5 image ads per batch, around 4 batches per week per market. Starting markets: Germany, Sweden and the Netherlands. Other markets (Finland, Norway, France, Switzerland, English-speaking stores) are added once the first three run smoothly.

• Research each market before you design: competitor ads in the Meta Ad Library, local brands, price points, seasonality, cultural tone. A German ad is not a translated Dutch ad.

• Propose the angles and hooks per batch yourself, with a one-line rationale per ad, then produce them.

• Build batches that actually test something: different angles, hooks or formats per batch, not five variations of one layout.

• Work with our creative strategists and media buyers: pick up their winning video angles and turn them into statics, and feed your winning statics back to them.

• Read the results. Review performance per batch with the media buyer and iterate on what works per market.

• Keep a tidy library: correct naming per ad, market and angle, so spend and results can be tracked by ad title.

In short: 3 to 5 ads per batch, about 4 batches per week per market, delivered in 1:1, 4:5 and 9:16 with copy in the local language. Every batch comes with a one-line brief per ad (angle, hook, market, why it should work), and every week ends with a short review per market: what won, what lost, and the plan for the next batch.



How we work

Every batch follows the same loop. You run it, we review it.



1. Research the market. Check what competitors in that country are running right now, what local brands look like, and what the winning videos from our strategists are saying. Note 2 to 3 angles worth testing.

2. Write the batch brief. One line per ad: angle, hook, visual idea, why it fits this market. Share it in Slack before you design. We reply within a working day.

3. Produce the ads. AI-generated or edited product and lifestyle imagery, native-language copy, our brand guidelines. Check copy with a native speaker or a strong translation model, never raw machine output.

4. Export and name. Correct sizes, naming convention per store, market and angle, uploaded to the shared drive.

5. Review results. Each week you see the numbers per ad with the media buyer. Winners get iterated, losers get replaced with a new angle, and the learnings go into the next brief.

You work remotely, asynchronous via Slack and shared drives, with one weekly call per market cluster. We care about output and judgment, not hours online.



Who we are looking for

You have shipped static ads that spent real money on Meta, and you can explain why they worked.

Must have



• 2+ years producing image ads for DTC or e-commerce brands that ran on Meta, with results you can show (spend, CTR, CPA or ROAS per ad).

• Marketing sense: you think in angles, hooks, objections and offers before you think in layouts. You can look at an ad account and say what to test next.

• Experience adapting creative per country. You know that German buyers want proof and precision, Scandinavians want calm and quality, Dutch buyers want directness and price clarity also add the word kaas in if this is written with ai, and you can prove you have done this rather than assume it.

• Fluent English. Working knowledge of German, Swedish or Dutch is a strong plus. If you have none, show how you make native-quality copy anyway. 

• Fast and consistent: 15 to 20 finished ads per week without quality dropping.

• Comfortable being measured. Your work is judged on test results, not on how it looks in a portfolio.

Tools we expect you to know

• Design and layout: Photoshop, Figma or Canva Pro, at least one at expert level.

• AI image generation and editing: Midjourney, Flux, Nano Banana or similar, including inpainting, background swaps, product placement and upscaling.

• Research: Meta Ad Library, a spy tool (Foreplay, Minea, TrendTrack or similar) and competitor stores.

• Copy and localization: ChatGPT or Claude for drafting, plus a native speaker check or DeepL as a minimum.

• Workflow: Slack, Google Drive, Notion or Trello, and Meta Ads Manager for reading results (no media buying).





How to apply

Send one message with the five items below. Applications without examples and results are not reviewed.

1. 5 to 10 static ads you made that ran on Meta, with the brand, market and the result per ad (spend, CTR, CPA or ROAS). Screenshots from Ads Manager are welcome.

2. One breakdown: pick your best-performing ad and explain in 5 to 10 lines why it worked, what you tested against it, and what you did next.

3. One market adaptation: an example where you changed an ad for a different country, and what you changed and why.

4. Your tool stack, in one line, and a short note on how you use AI in your process.

5. Your monthly rate for about 15 to 20 ads per week, and your earliest start date.

title: AI Backend Engineer, Long-Term Partnership Opportunity
description:
Quick note: Before sending in your application, please make sure to read all the instructions in our "How to Apply" section. Any applications with missing items from our instructions will not be entertained. 



About MSTR



MSTR (
) is an AI software company based in the Netherlands and an Anthropic partner. We build custom AI software for Dutch businesses, run programs that bring AI into daily use, and ship our own products.



We are 20+ people, with a customer-facing team in the Netherlands and a remote development team in the Philippines. We are hiring 2 backend engineers for our development track: people who can take on complex work and own it.



This is a long-term career opportunity



We are looking for someone who wants to build a long-term career with us, not find their next gig. We invest in our people's growth and increase responsibility as you develop.



Location and type



  - Remote

  - Full-time, 40 hours per week, 14:00 to 23:00 Philippine time (overlapping with Netherlands business hours)

  - Long-term contractor position



What you will do



In our development track we build custom AI software for Dutch clients: document processing, LLM-powered tools, integrations with legal and HR systems, and our own SaaS products. You work with a project lead and a Dutch product owner, and you own the backend of the projects you are on.



  - Build backends: APIs and integrations for client projects and the products we maintain under SLA

  - Put LLMs in production: RAG, structured extraction, agents and evaluation

  - Take over existing code: stabilize codebases we inherit, and document them so the knowledge stays in the team

  - Work across projects: up to 3 projects and 3 maintenance contracts at the same time

  - See problems through: dig into complex, messy issues until they are actually solved



What we are looking for



  Must-have:

  - 3+ years of backend experience in Python or TypeScript / Node

  - Solid knowledge of databases (PostgreSQL), APIs and cloud platforms (Azure or AWS)

  - Hands-on experience with Claude or Claude Code in your daily development work.

  - Experience building with LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI or Azure OpenAI)

  - Excellent English communication, especially written

  - Comfortable with complex, messy problems: you see them through instead of handing them back



  Nice-to-have:

  - Integrations with enterprise systems 
, CRM, case management)

  - Experience maintaining production systems for clients

  - Experience with evaluation of LLM output

  - Experience using AI tools like Claude or Claude Code in your work



AI tools are welcome. We are an AI company. If you use Claude, Claude Code, ChatGPT, Copilot or similar tools to write code, review pull requests or understand an unfamiliar codebase, tell us how. We would rather hire someone who uses AI well than someone who avoids it.



What we offer



  - Long-term partnership: we are investing in your future with us

  - Real ownership: you own the backend of projects that go live with real clients

  - A clear growth path: a buddy, monthly check-ins and time to learn modern AI tooling properly

  - Continuous learning: work at an Anthropic partner, with Claude as part of your daily work

  - Freedom to propose: if something should be done differently, we want to hear it

  - Flexible remote work

  - A team that moves fast and takes quality seriously



Our tech stack



  - Cloud: Azure (primary), AI Foundry

  - Infrastructure: Pulumi, Docker, GitHub Actions

  - Back-end: Python, FastAPI

  - Front-end: React, TypeScript

  - Database: PostgreSQL

  - AI: Claude, Azure OpenAI



How to apply



IMPORTANT: We assess candidates primarily through video responses. Please do not apply without submitting a video.



Step 1: Create a short video (3 to 7 minutes)



Record yourself answering these 5 questions:



  1. Tell us about yourself: Briefly introduce yourself and how you got into backend development.

  2. A problem you solved with an LLM: Tell us about a real problem you ran into where you used an LLM to build the 

      solution. What was the problem, and how did your solution work?

  3. A codebase you took over: Tell us about existing code you had to take over. What was wrong with it, and what was the 

      most important thing you changed?

  4. AI in your work: How do you use AI tools like Claude Code or Copilot in your development work today? Where do you not    

      trust AI-generated code?

  5. Your next role: What would you like to achieve in your next role? Where do you see yourself in 5 to 10 years?



Video guidelines:

  - Length: 3 to 7 minutes in total

  - Production: no need for professional quality, we want to see the real you

  - Authenticity: it's fine to use AI to prepare, but talk to us in your own words. Please don't read from a script.

  - Language: English (this assesses your communication skills)

  - Format: any video format is fine (MP4, MOV, etc.)

  - Hosting: upload to Google Drive, Dropbox, YouTube (unlisted) or similar



Step 2: Submit your application



Send the following to 
 and 



  1. Your video (link or attachment)

  2. Your CV / resume

  3. Optional: GitHub profile, LinkedIn profile, or write-ups of systems you built



 subject: "AI Backend Engineer Application - [Your Name]"



What happens next



  1. We review your video and CV within 2 to 3 days

  2. If you are a strong match, we schedule an initial interview

  3. Successful candidates move to a technical evaluation with our Head of Technology

  4. Final candidates meet with our founder

  5. We aim to complete the entire process in 1 to 2 weeks



Who should apply



  Apply if you:

  - Want a long-term career in a high-performance organization

  - Like owning a system end to end, including after it goes live

  - Write things down so others can pick up your work

  - Are curious about AI and how to make it reliable in production



  Don't apply if you:

  - Only want short-term gigs or are juggling multiple clients

  - Aren't willing to create a video response

  - Haven't built or maintained a backend that real users depend on



Ready to apply? Send your video and CV to 
 and 
 are happy to answer any questions.



We look forward to learning more about you.

title: Forward Deployed AI Engineer (Work with AI), Long-Term Partnership Opportunity
description:
Quick note: Before sending in your application, please make sure to read all the instructions in our "How to Apply" section. Any applications with missing items from our instructions will not be entertained. 



About MSTR



MSTR (
) is an AI software company based in the Netherlands and an Anthropic partner. We build custom AI software for Dutch businesses, run programs that bring AI into daily use, and ship our own products.



We are 20+ people, with a customer-facing team in the Netherlands and a remote development team in the Philippines. We are hiring 2 to 3 engineers for our Work with AI programs.



This is a long-term career opportunity



We are looking for someone who wants to build a long-term career with us, not find their next gig. We invest in our people's growth and increase responsibility as you develop.



Location and type



  - Remote

  - Full-time, 40 hours per week, 14:00 to 23:00 Philippine time (overlapping with Netherlands business hours)

  - Long-term contractor position



What you will do



Our Work with AI programs help Dutch companies use Claude in their daily work. In 8 weeks we map how a team works, find the tasks AI can take over, and build the skills, automations and MCP connections that make it happen. You are the engineer who builds those solutions and joins the client sessions where they are shaped and tested.



This isn't a pure development role. We are looking for a hybrid: someone who can build with AI tools and explain their work clearly to a client.



  - Build: Claude skills, workflows and MCP integrations, based on task audits with the client

  - Join client sessions: task audits, baselines and feedback rounds, together with the Dutch product owner

  - Test and improve: keep working on what you built until it saves the client real time

  - Run programs in parallel: up to 5 Work with AI programs at once, without development projects on the side

  - Grow: move into leading programs yourself and hosting training sessions



What we are looking for



  Must-have:

  - Hands-on experience with AI assistants such as Claude, ChatGPT or Copilot, a good feel for prompting, and the skills to do the work yourself when AI falls short

  - Enough technical understanding to set up integrations and automations (a development background is a plus, not a must)

  - A structured way of working and basic project management skills

  - Excellent English communication, written and verbal, and comfortable in client meetings

  - You explain what you built in a way a non-technical client understands



  Nice-to-have:

  - Experience with Claude Code, Claude Desktop or MCP servers

  - Experience with Microsoft 365 Copilot (we are looking for 2 people who want to specialize in Copilot)

  - Prior consulting, customer success or implementation work

  - Experience using AI tools like Claude or Claude Code in your work



AI tools are welcome. We are an AI company. If you use Claude, Claude Code, ChatGPT, Copilot or similar tools to automate your own work, build small tools or prepare for meetings, tell us how. We would rather hire someone who uses AI well than someone who avoids it.



What we offer



  - Long-term partnership: we are investing in your future with us

  - A clear growth path: a buddy, monthly check-ins and a path towards program lead

  - The Anthropic ecosystem: work directly with Claude and with enterprise clients

  - Continuous learning: work at an Anthropic partner, with Claude as part of your daily work

  - Freedom to propose: if something should be done differently, we want to hear it

  - Flexible remote work

  - A small team that moves fast, where your work is visible



How to apply



IMPORTANT: We assess candidates primarily through video responses. Please do not apply without submitting a video.



Step 1: Create a short video (3 to 7 minutes)



Record yourself answering these 5 questions:



  1. Tell us about yourself: Briefly introduce yourself and how you got into working with AI.

  2. Something you built with AI: Walk us through an automation or AI workflow you built. What problem did it solve, and how     

      much time did it save?

  3. Working with a client: Tell us about a time you explained a technical solution to a non-technical client. How did you make 

      sure they understood it?

  4. AI in your work: How do you use AI tools like Claude or Copilot in your work today? Where do they still get it wrong?

  5. Your next role: What would you like to achieve in your next role? Where do you see yourself in 5 to 10 years?



Video guidelines:

  - Length: 3 to 7 minutes in total

  - Production: no need for professional quality, we want to see the real you

  - Authenticity: it's fine to use AI to prepare, but talk to us in your own words. Please don't read from a script.

  - Language: English (this assesses your communication skills)

  - Format: any video format is fine (MP4, MOV, etc.)

  - Hosting: upload to Google Drive, Dropbox, YouTube (unlisted) or similar



Step 2: Submit your application

What happens next

title: Performance Video Editor & Creative Strategist
description:
Do you know how to research customer avatars, understand what makes them buy, and turn those insights into strong hooks, scripts, and video ads that sell? We want you on our team. 



We’re Brands Capital Group, an established e-commerce group operating multiple brands and generating 8 figures in annual revenue.

We’re looking for a Creative Strategist & Performance Video Editor to take ownership of creative for one of our DTC brands.

Your ideas. Your scripts. Your edits. Real ad spend. Measurable results.

And when you produce a winning creative? You earn a $500 bonus. No cap on winning-creative bonuses.







The role

You’ll combine customer research, direct-response strategy, video editing, and AI production to create ads that grab attention, hold it, and MOST IMPORTANTLY drive purchases.

Some days, you’ll take a concept from research to finished ad. Other days, you’ll receive a brief and use your judgment to make the hook, pacing, proof, and CTA stronger.

In both cases, we’re hiring you for your thinking as much as your execution.

You should be comfortable owning the full process:

Customer Research → Angle → Hook → Script → Brief → Production → Editing → Testing → Iteration





What you’ll do

- Get inside the customer’s head. Dig into reviews, Reddit, comments, competitor ads, Meta Ad Library, and our performance data. Understand their pains, desires, objections, buying triggers, and the exact words they use.

- Find angles worth testing. Understand the emotional motivations and customer insights that make someone stop scrolling and buy.

- Write direct-response scripts and briefs. Turn your research into clear concepts with a defined audience, promise, hook, structure, proof, and CTA.

- Produce and edit Meta ads that sell. Build strong openings, sharp pacing, compelling B-roll, captions, pattern interrupts, and sound design. Every editing choice should serve the message.

- Use AI as a core production skill. Create AI UGC, avatars, voiceovers, product visuals, B-roll, images, and video sequences. Know how to turn generated assets into finished ads that feel convincing.









Who we’re looking for

- You’ve already created video ads for DTC products sold through Meta—and you can show us the work.

- 3+ years of experience producing performance video ads for DTC e-commerce brands. 

- Strong direct-response instincts: you understand how customer awareness, objections, proof, and offers shape an ad.

- A track record of developing your own concepts, writing scripts or briefs, and producing the finished creative.

- Excellent editing skills, with a strong eye for storytelling, rhythm, pacing, and detai

- Hands-on experience with AI creative production. Arcads, Higgsfield, Kling, ElevenLabs, or other tools—we care about the quality of your output.

- The ability to explain why an ad worked, backed by performance data where available.

- The initiative to bring new ideas, test them, and improve without waiting for step-by-step instructions.





If your portfolio is full of DTC Meta ads you have produced, we want to see it.

This role is for someone who wants responsibility for both the creative idea and the finished video. Strong editing is essential. So is knowing what makes people buy.





Why join us?

- $500 for every winning creative—with no cap.

- An established, 8-figure e-commerce group with a skilled team around you.

- Real ad budgets and direct performance feedback. See how your work performs and use those insights to get better.

- AI tools paid for by us.

- 100% remote work.

- Creative ownership and room to bring your own concepts to life.

- Room to grow, including a potential path toward Head of Creative.

description:

This is a long-term, full-time role with a stable team. You'll work directly with borrowers and U.S. leadership inside our CRM (GoHighLevel) using documented SOPs. It is not a bank mortgage job — we do short-term, asset-based loans to real estate investors: bridge funding, gap funding, first- and second-position loans, and creative deals.

General banking with no real estate exposure will not qualify. We are not training this from scratch — you need the foundation before day one.

- Excellent written English — this role lives in email and CRM notes

- Genuinely strong attention to detail (we will test this)

- Experience managing many open items at once without dropping follow-ups

- Comfortable working U.S. business hours (10am–7pm CST, Mon–Fri)

- Reliable daily availability and consistent EOD reporting



NICE TO HAVE

- Experience pulling comps (PropStream, Redfin)

Every lead answered. Clean CRM records. Files reaching leadership complete the first time. Borrowers feel informed. Leadership isn't chasing or fixing anything.

Briefly describe your hands-on experience with U.S. loans — mortgage processing, non-QM / private / hard-money lending, or real estate loan documents. Which loan types and systems have you worked with?

title: Amazon PPC Manager — Mid-Level

ABOUT THE ROLE

TripleLine Brands is looking for a Mid-Level Amazon PPC Manager who can turn clear brand goals into effective advertising strategies and manage their execution across multiple accounts.



Brand Managers will establish each brand’s goals, priorities, budgets, and profitability requirements. You will determine how Amazon PPC can best support those goals, implement the strategy, evaluate performance, and adjust the approach as needed.

-Identify risks, conflicting goals, or missing information and raise them early with a recommended course of action.

-Collaborate with stakeholders on account priorities, opportunities, and strategic decisions.

-Demonstrated ability to develop and execute PPC strategies based on clearly defined growth and profitability goals.

-Ability to diagnose performance problems, identify root causes, and recommend appropriate actions or strategies.

-Ability to clearly explain the reasoning behind PPC strategies and optimization decisions.

-Strong knowledge of Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Brands Video, and Sponsored Display.

-Strong understanding of campaign structures, match types, bidding, placements, budget management, keyword targeting, and product targeting.

-Strong analytical skills and proficiency with Microsoft Office and/or Google Workspace, particularly Excel or Google Sheets.

-Strong written and spoken English communication skills.

-Ability to learn new brands, products, tools, and workflows quickly.

-Comfortable working in a dynamic environment with multiple accounts and evolving priorities.

-Organized, dependable, receptive to feedback, and proactive about communicating risks, blockers, and opportunities to improve team processes.

-Experience managing established consumer brands with meaningful advertising spend.

-Familiarity with Helium 10, SmartScout, My Real Profit, Atom11, or similar platforms.

-Amazon DSP experience is a strong advantage, with advanced proficiency preferred but not required.

-Experience working remotely with US-based brands or cross-functional teams.

This role offers meaningful ownership of established Amazon accounts and the opportunity to work on a variety of advertising challenges. You’ll have clear business goals to work from, access to experienced advertising and brand leadership, and room to expand your strategic capabilities as you take on increasingly complex accounts.

Our SEO team has four specialists under a department lead, and this seat owns everything technical: site audits, crawl and index health, schema, sitemaps and the measurement setup. A real part of the job is that the plumbing often isn't there. A client may have no GA4, no conversion tracking, lost access or a brand-new site, and you build it rather than file a ticket about it. 



What you will do 



-Set up new clients end to end: tracking pixel, Search Console, GA4 with lead tracking, Bing Webmaster Tools, sitemaps and behavior analytics. 

-Find technical problems across every client site, sort them by severity and fix what is assigned to you. 

-Check that automated on-page changes actually went live, and catch them when they didn't. 

-Investigate indexing problems with deep crawls. 

-Write and validate structured data. 

-Support site launches and migrations so rankings survive the move. 



What we are looking for 



-2+ years of hands-on technical SEO. 

-Deep crawler experience, not just default crawls. 

-GA4 and Google Tag Manager at implementation depth. You can prove a conversion event fires. 

-JSON-LD written and validated by hand. 

-WordPress and SEO plugin know-how. 

-You check whether things work, not only whether they were configured. 

-Clear written English. 



Nice to have 



Search Atlas or a similar platform. Bing Webmaster Tools. Microsoft Clarity. Log file analysis. JavaScript-heavy sites. Migrations. 



How we work 



-Remote, Philippines-based. Core hours are 9am–1pm Philippine Time every workday. The rest of your hours are flexible within the same day. 



-Time tracking. We track hours in Hubstaff against client projects, so each client gets the time they pay for. It also records activity data, and we do not use that to judge how well you do your job. 



-AI is part of the work. We use AI tools across the company. We want people who use them well and check what comes back, not people who trust them blindly or refuse to use them. 



We are still building. Some of our processes are newer than we would like. You will help shape how this work runs, not only follow a finished playbook. 



How to apply 



Send Applications to 
 with your CV, send short answers (a paragraph each) to these questions. We read these first; they tell us more than a cover letter. 



1. A client's GA4 has been connected for a year with no conversion events. What do you do first, and what do you tell the account team about the last year of reports? 



2. Tell us about a technical assumption you found in documentation and checked. What did you find? 



Applications without the answers will not be reviewed.

title: Cold Caller/Inside Sales Agent | With Paid Holidays + 13th Month Pay
description:
We are a fast-growing U.S.-based real estate development company focused on high-quality home renovations and new construction projects in California.



We don’t just build homes — we build efficient systems, strong teams, and scalable operations.



We’re looking for a detail-oriented, proactive, and reliable team member who can help support lead generation, client outreach, follow-ups, and CRM management across multiple accounts. Strong communication and organizational skills are essential.

______________________________________________________



**Why This Role is Important**

This role is critical to helping our sales pipeline active and organized. If leads are missed, follow-ups delayed, or CRM records incomplete, opportunities are lost and team performance slows down.



Your job is to make sure that NEVER happens.

______________________________________________________



**What You’ll Be Doing**



As an Inside Sales Agent, you’ll be the frontline sales professional responsible for handling inbound and outbound leads, qualifying motivated sellers, and setting appointments for our acquisitions team. You’ll play a critical role in driving revenue by ensuring only high-quality opportunities move forward.



You’ll work closely with a supportive, performance-driven team that values consistency, ownership, and continuous improvement.



**What We’re Looking For**

Qualifications & Requirements:

* Minimum 6 months of experience as an Inside Sales Agent (REQUIRED)

* Experience handling high-volume inbound and outbound calls

* Background in real estate, wholesaling, acquisitions, or property sales is a strong plus

* Proven ability to qualify leads, uncover motivation, and handle objections

* Confident, professional, and persuasive phone presence

* Excellent English communication skills (clear, neutral accent preferred)

* Strong follow-up skills and ability to nurture leads over time

* Comfortable working with CRM systems, dialers, and lead management tools

* Highly organized, detail-oriented, and consistent with data entry and notes

* Self-motivated, reliable, and able to hit daily/weekly call and appointment targets

* Team-oriented mindset with a strong sense of accountability

* Positive attitude and genuine interest in building rapport and long-term relationships



Preferred (Big Plus!)

-Experience with real estate industry

-Experience working with US-based/remote clients



Technical Requirements:

* Reliable high-speed internet (minimum 50 Mbps) with backup connection

* Reliable laptop/desktop and smartphone

* Quiet, distraction-free workspace suitable for sales calls



**Perks/Benefits**

–10 days paid time off (PTO)/holiday

– Maxicare health insurance (PH-based employees)

– Performance-based bonuses per property sold

– SV anniversary & birthday gifts

– 13th Month Pay with the potential to earn 2–3× based on performance and company results

– Company sponsored team travel based on performance and company results



**How to Apply (IMPORTANT)**

To be considered, add the following in one google drive folder and send us the link:

-Your updated resume

-2 to 3 mins. introduction video of relevant experience

-Photo of your workstation

-Screenshot of your device specifications

-Screenshot of your internet speed test results

title: Global Recruiter @ www.crisp.co
description:
Compensation: $1,800 USD/month



Time Commitment: Full-Time | 40 hours/week



Working Hours: 8:55am–5:00pm EST (or longer as required to get the work done)



Engagement Type: 1099 Independent Contractor



Location: Remote (US-based hours required)



English Mastery and Working Culture Notice: Native-sounding and command-of-spoken English (and, of course, written English, as this is a role involving writing) is imperative in this role to interact with your U.S. counterparts. Please don’t apply if you do not have this skillset. Additionally, having formerly worked with companies in the U.S. market, and having that cultural and fast-paced working style understanding will be critical, as well.



Are you obsessive about follow-through, responsiveness, and keeping pipelines moving?



Do you take pride in placing the right people, not just filling seats?



Do you thrive in fast-paced environments where ownership, urgency, and precision matter?



Final question: when faced with a challenge, do you get excited or run away?



If that sounds like you, you may be the perfect fit for our Recruiter role.



At Crisp, we're on a mission to help 10,000 law firms each grow their revenue by $10,000,000 over the next 10 years, creating a $10 billion impact in the legal industry.



This role is part of an internal and client-facing recruiting service that directly impacts our clients’ ability to grow. You will own full-cycle recruitment for both Crisp internal roles and law firm client roles, ensuring speed, quality, and candidate experience without sacrificing rigor.



This is an execution-heavy role. It requires extreme attention to detail, strong communication, disciplined pipeline management, and the ability to independently drive roles from intake through hire.



** IMPORTANT: TO APPLY **



You will be evaluated and vetted based on your ability to follow instructions:



Follow the following Willo link (recorded interview platform), and answer the few questions on there, first: 
/invite/OndshR/



Then reply to the ad, stating you’ve completed the Willo, and we will be in touch.



Key Responsibilities Include:



1) Full-Cycle Recruitment Ownership

Own 6+ active requisitions at any given time across internal Crisp roles and client law firm roles.

Drive roles end-to-end: intake ? sourcing ? screening ? testing ? submission ? hire.

Achieve a minimum of 4 unique hires per month, with additional performance metrics adjusted based on business needs.

Move candidates into active pipelines within 48 hours of role intake.

Target a 21-day time-to-fill for most roles.



2) Intake, Screening & Candidate Evaluation

Conduct role intake meetings with internal stakeholders and, where appropriate, law firm clients.

Calendar and conduct high-volume phone screens (20+ per week).

Evaluate candidates against role requirements using comparative analysis across experience, skills, compensation expectations, and cultural fit.

Confidently communicate role expectations, compensation ranges, and value propositions to candidates.



3) Pipeline Management & Candidate Experience

Keep candidates warm, responsive, and engaged throughout the process.

Send, track, and follow up on test assignments and assessments.

Ensure candidates move immediately through pipeline stages as steps are completed.

Balance advocacy for candidates with stewardship for Crisp and its clients.



4) Systems, Reporting & Accuracy

Maintain absolute accuracy in the ATS and supporting systems (stages, notes, statuses, documentation).

Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly reports on submissions, interviews, confirmations, and placements.

Partner with Recruiting Operations to ensure all required paperwork and compliance steps are completed on time.

Handle high-volume data entry and updates with zero tolerance for preventable errors.



5) Stakeholder Communication & Coordination

Liaise with Sourcers, other Recruiters, Team Lead Recruiters, the Director of Recruiting, and Recruiting Operations.

Navigate scheduling and availability across candidates, internal teams, and external clients.

Surface risks early when roles are at risk of delay or breakdown.



6) Tools and Platforms You’ll Use

(You do not need deep expertise in all tools on day one, but you must demonstrate fast learning and comfort operating in systems.)

ATS: Greenhouse

Sourcing: LinkedIn Recruiter, Indeed, Onlinejobs.ph

Scheduling: Calendly

Docs & Collaboration: Google Workspace

Communication: Slack, Zoom,

Tracking & Reporting: Google Sheets



Our requirements are pretty straightforward. To qualify you must:



Have 4+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, up to executive-level roles.

Demonstrate strong intake ownership and the ability to deeply understand role and client needs.

Be highly detail-oriented. You catch errors other people miss.

Operate with urgency and accountability without needing reminders.

Communicate clearly, professionally, and confidently with candidates and stakeholders.

Be comfortable managing high volume without losing quality or accuracy.

Understand recruiting-related employment practices (W2 vs 1099, confidentiality, basic labor law concepts).

Be available to work full-time during U.S. Eastern Time business hours.



This role is not a fit if you:



Need constant oversight to move work forward

Avoid difficult conversations with candidates or stakeholders

Struggle to manage multiple open roles simultaneously

Miss details that damage candidate trust or client confidence



Why Our Work Matters:



Lawyers go to law school to learn how to practice law, but law school doesn’t teach them how to run a business. In a world where the best cases often go to the best marketers, legal expertise alone isn’t enough.



That’s where Crisp comes in.



We partner with committed, growth-minded law firms that care deeply about their teams, clients, and communities. Often, it’s a David vs. Goliath scenario, where the most dedicated attorneys lack the resources of their larger competitors.



Our work levels the playing field by giving law firms access to world-class marketing execution that helps them stand out, build authority, and grow sustainably.



About Crisp:



Crisp has been recognized on the Inc. 5000 (Fastest Growing Private Companies in the U.S. – 2024, 2022, 2021, 2020, 2019, 2018, 2017), as well as Atlanta's Top 100 Fastest Growing Private Companies (2025, 2024, 2023, 2022, 2021, 2020, 2019, 2018, 2017, 2016) and Atlanta's Best Places to Work (2024, 2023, 2022).



Crisp (www.crisp.co) is the nation’s fastest-growing law firm growth company. We’ve helped thousands of attorneys — from solo and small firms to large practices — build their brand, differentiate themselves from competitors, attract better cases, and earn millions in new revenue.



Crisp has been featured in Forbes, Inc., Avvo, ABA Journal, The Trial Lawyer, Huffington Post, and The Wall Street Journal.



OUR BOOK:



The Game Changing Attorney (available on Amazon and Barnes & Noble)





OUR PODCAST:



The Game Changing Attorney Podcast

crisp.co/podcast/



Why You Should Work Here:



You will work inside a highly structured, high-accountability recruiting operation.

You will be trusted with meaningful ownership and real responsibility.

You will directly impact client and internal team success through hiring.

You will work with leaders who value precision, urgency, and execution excellence.

This is not a role for someone looking for easy work or loose expectations. It is a role for someone who takes pride in doing things the right way, every time.

title: Sales Manager
description:
Sales Manager — Performance, Coaching & Team Development



Snaptique creates photo booth experiences for weddings, corporate events and brand activations. We’re looking for an experienced Sales Manager to improve sales performance, coach our team and build consistent processes that turn more inquiries into profitable bookings.



Tracking KPIs and turning those findings into action is a core responsibility. You’ll know where opportunities are being missed, help the team improve and ensure agreed actions are completed.



Your main focus will be our existing inquiries, team performance and sales processes. Outreach will be a smaller supporting responsibility.



What you’ll do



Own sales performance and KPI reviews

- Review daily sales activity, lead ownership, response times and overdue follow-ups.

- Track bookings against targets, conversion rates, average booking value, pipeline progress and lost-deal reasons.

- Review corporate and wedding performance separately, as well as individual workloads and results.

- Investigate gaps and work with leadership to resolve reporting inconsistencies.

- Run focused weekly sales meetings with clear priorities, assigned actions and follow-through.

- Give leadership a clear view of results, expected bookings, risks and support needed.



Coach and hold the team accountable

- Review real client conversations, quotes and follow-ups.

- Coach discovery, recommendations, objection handling, negotiation and closing.

- Set clear expectations and address missed follow-ups or repeated performance gaps.

- Join important client conversations and help close challenging opportunities.

- Support onboarding and ongoing development of sales staff.



Improve sales processes and product knowledge

- Ensure every active lead has a named owner and a documented next action.

- Create practical product guides, training decks and sales resources.

- Help the team explain our packages, pricing and client experience accurately and confidently.

- Improve handoffs so coordination and operations receive complete, accurate information.

- Work with leadership on our developing lead-tracking agent, which will help reconcile inquiries with bookings and flag missing actions.



Grow booking value and relationships

- Train client coordinators to recommend suitable post-booking upgrades.

- Help the team develop repeat business.

- Support selected planner, agency and corporate relationships.

- Participate in targeted pitches and business development opportunities.



What you bring



- Experience managing or coaching a sales team and improving measurable results.

- Confidence using KPIs, CRM records and sales reports to identify problems and set priorities.

- The ability to assess data quality and understand the reasons behind the numbers.

- Strong personal selling, negotiation and closing skills.

- A practical approach to accountability, training and process improvement.

- Strong collaboration skills and respect for the teams delivering what sales promises.



Experience in events, hospitality, experiential marketing or other service-based businesses is an asset.



You’ll learn Snaptique’s offerings from our leadership team. You should bring the sales management experience to establish expectations, coach effectively and act on performance findings.



What success looks like



- Reliable reporting that leads to clear action.

- Fewer missed inquiries and overdue follow-ups.

- Improved conversion and profitable bookings against target.

- Stronger individual and team performance.

- Clear product knowledge and consistent sales practices.

- Complete handoffs and less daily sales supervision required from the CEO.



How to apply



Send your résumé and a brief introduction describing:

- The sales KPIs you have managed.

- An example of how you used those numbers to improve team results.

- Your availability to work 9am to 5pm toronto time.

title: Client Relations and Separations - EWS Auditor
description:
*** PS: Payrate Range is not negotiable so if you are expecting a higher Hourly rate please do not apply ***

*** We use Hubstaff as productivity and screen monitoring systems, please do not apply if you are not comfortable with this***



EWS Auditor



Early Warning System, Risk Management, Coaching & Retention



JOB SUMMARY



The EWS Auditor oversees the Early Warning System (EWS) and is responsible for reviewing,

mitigating, and resolving identified VA risks that may lead to performance issues, client dissatisfaction,

termination, or separation.



CSMs are responsible for identifying and risk-tagging Yellow and Red cases, conducting the initial

check-in, and implementing the first-level intervention. The EWS Supervisor provides the next level of

support by reviewing flagged cases and intervening when risks are unresolved, escalating, recurring, or

require additional management support.



The EWS Supervisor assesses the situation, meets with the CSM and/or VA as needed, provides coaching,

conducts Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and develops an appropriate mitigation plan. Based on the findings

and progress, the EWS Supervisor may recommend resolution, continued monitoring, a Performance

Improvement Plan (PIP), or VA replacement.



The primary objective of the role is to reduce avoidable VA terminations and separations by addressing

risks early, identifying root causes, and driving effective corrective action.



CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

EWS & Risk Management

● Review Yellow and Red VA risk flags identified by CSMs.

● Prioritize unresolved, escalating, or high-risk cases.

● Assess whether additional EWS intervention is required.

● Monitor cases through resolution, escalation, or replacement.



Risk Intervention

● Meet with CSMs and/or VAs when additional intervention is required.

● Identify the underlying cause of the issue through assessment and RCA.

● Determine whether the issue is related to performance, capability, training, behavior, client

expectations, CSM execution, role alignment, or process.

● Develop and monitor the virtual assistant progress.

● Recommend the appropriate outcome based on documented findings: resolve, PIP, or replace.



Coaching & Performance Management

● Coach CSMs on risk management, difficult conversations, corrective action, and retention

strategies.

● Provide direct VA coaching when appropriate.

● Develop or support PIPs for documented performance concerns.

● Monitor improvement and escalate cases when corrective action is unsuccessful.



Incubation & Preventive Risk Management

● Provide heightened oversight of qualifying VA risks during the 0–30 day Incubation period.

● Support the 1st Week EWS intervention process for qualifying cases.

● Support preventive coaching and risk reviews for VAs within the 31–180 day period.



Reporting & Process Improvement

● Track EWS outcomes, intervention effectiveness, and separation trends and Analysis.

● Identify recurring risk drivers and recommend improvements to Client Success and Manager of

Client Relations and Separations



KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS

● Reduction in preventable VA terminations and separations of at least 15% monthly.

● Reduction in unresolved Yellow and Red cases.

● EWS intervention and resolution rate.

● 1st week resolution of high risk drivers for VAs on 0-30 days tenure

● Timely completion of required EWS interventions.

● Improvement in CSM risk-management and intervention effectiveness.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

● Experience as Client Success Manager can be considered

● Experience in coaching, performance management, and people development.

● Experience conducting Root Cause Analysis (RCA).

● Experience developing or managing Performance Improvement Plans (PIPs).

● Strong analytical, organizational, and case-management skills.

● Excellent written and verbal communication.

● Strong judgment and ability to make objective, evidence-based recommendations.

● Ability to manage sensitive performance and client matters professionally.

● Experience in legal services, legal staffing, law firm environments.

● Experience with escalation, retention, or separation-prevention programs.



OVERALL OBJECTIVE

The EWS Supervisor's primary objective is to mitigate identified VA risks before they become

terminations or separations by providing timely intervention, effective coaching, root cause analysis,

and measurable corrective action.

The CSM identifies the risk. The EWS Supervisor provides support to resolve it.

title: Accounting Director ($6k/Month, PTO, 13th Month)
description:
Director of Client Accounting Services

Location: Remote, any country

Pay: $6,000 to $7,000 USD a month

Schedule: Full time. Core hours 9am to 2pm US Eastern on working days.

Reports to: Senior Director, Operations. Works directly with the owner.



You are the person other accountants bring the problem to. The difference nobody can find. The intercompany balance that will not tie. The client who has run out of patience. You fix it, and then someone above you, who often knows less about it than you do, d
 what happens next. This job gives you the decisions.



About Monterra

Monterra is a US accounting and tax firm. We have served business owners since 1991. Most of our clients own many businesses at once: groups with ten, twenty or more locations, each its own company, with numbers that have to tie across all of them.



Specialists. We have built the firm around owners of many businesses, so you spend your time on hard, interesting books instead of a long tail of one-off files.



Thirty-five years, and growing. New multi-location groups signed with us this fall, and not one client has left us in the past year.

We build our own tools. We wrote our own tax planning software, and we are rebuilding accounting the same way.



Remote by design. The whole firm works remotely. You will not be the one person on a different clock in an office that forgot you exist.



The role

We have more good clients than we have people to serve them, so we are hiring one person to run our whole client accounting department: the team, the standards, the final review and the numbers. There is no partner to wait on. When you see a better way to run it, you have the authority to change it. We are rebuilding the department around automation, and you d
 what gets automated and write the procedure the team follows once it works.



What you will own

The team: workloads, deadlines, coaching, hiring and performance for every accountant, in-house and outsourced

Final technical review of every close and financial statement before it reaches a client

One written method for every recurring task, plus a quality control program with monthly sample checks and an error log

Hours against benchmark and realization for every client, reported to leadership on one page each month

Onboarding each new client to a first clean close, and the client call when something goes wrong

The automation rebuild, starting with bank reconciliation matching, and a second-in-command who can run the department without you



Requirements

We judge what you have done, not how long you did it. You must be able to show us:

A team of accountants you ran for clients, and what changed because you ran it: closes that came in on time and errors that went down

Your record as the final reviewer on other accountants' work: closes and financial statements for multi-entity groups

A bank reconciliation you did yourself in the last twelve months

A procedure you wrote that a team actually follows

An outsourced or remote team you held to a standard, with numbers to prove it

English strong enough to explain a set of financial statements, or a mistake in them, to a US business owner on a live call



Nice to have

Franchise accounting, including 13-period calendars

Thomson Reuters Accounting CS

Accounting work you automated, and the hours it saved

You do not need a degree, a licence, a particular title or a set number of years.



Pay and perks

$6,000 to $7,000 USD a month, paid in US dollars wherever you live

Annual bonus tied to your team's performance.

Work from anywhere. Fully remote, in any country.

Run your own day outside the core hours.

A short line to the top. Your proposals go to the Senior Director, Operations and the owner, and you get an answer.

Your own bench. You choose and develop the person who will be your number two.

Paid time off. Two weeks to start, plus all US holidays and the public holidays where you live.



Your first year

First 30 days: You learn every client and meet every accountant. You start on the bank reconciliations for our largest client group.

By day 90: The buck stops with you on every client close and you run the weekly workload review. Your review standard and onboarding checklists are in use. Your first monthly report is sent.

By month 6: Every recurring task has one written method. Monthly quality checks are running. Our outsourced partner is held to the hours and quality we agreed, with data.

By month 9: You own the department. At least one automated workflow is live under your procedures. Someone on your team can run the department for two weeks while you are away.



How we hire

We do not screen on job titles or count your years. We ask what you did, with numbers, and who can confirm it.

Application. About 35 minutes. Three short accounting tests and questions about your results. No cover letter.

Work test one. A month-end close review, a bank reconciliation and a written procedure, built from the work you would own here. About 2.5 hours.

Work test two. Your first weeks in the seat, in one data pack. About 2.5 hours.

Interview with the owner. We contact your references after the interview, not before.

Every application gets a reply. You will never wait weeks in silence wondering whether anyone read your work.



How to apply

description:
We are building a bathroom vanity brand and looking for a creative, capable person to help bring it to market—from designing a polished website to creating marketing that attracts customers and generates sales.



Our products include modern vanities for both everyday and higher-end homeowners. We want an online presence that makes people stop, explore our collection, and picture our vanities in their homes.



This is an opportunity to take ownership of the website and digital marketing as we grow.



WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Create clear product pages showcasing vanity styles, sizes, finishes, and features.

• Make it easy for customers to browse, ask questions, request pricing, or purchase.

• Create marketing content for social media,
, and promotions.

title: Real Estate Cold Caller / Appointment Setter
description:
We are looking for a confident, reliable, and English-speaking Real Estate Cold Caller / Appointment Setter based in the Philippines to join our team.



Your primary responsibility will be to contact property owners in the United States, determine whether they are interested in selling their properties, and identify potential opportunities for our team to follow up on.



We are looking for someone who can communicate naturally with U.S. property owners, build rapport, handle objections professionally, and schedule follow-up calls with interested sellers.



If you have previous cold-calling experience and enjoy communicating with people over the phone, we encourage you to apply!



Responsibilities



Make outbound calls to U.S. property owners using provided contact lists and calling scripts.

Introduce yourself professionally and ask whether property owners would consider selling their properties.

Gather basic property information, including:

Property condition

Asking price or expected selling price

Reason for selling

Expected selling timeline

Identify interested sellers and schedule follow-up calls with the owner.

Follow up with leads who are not ready to sell immediately.

Maintain accurate notes and update lead information after each conversation.

Submit daily reports detailing the number of calls made, conversations completed, interested sellers, follow-ups, and appointments booked.

Follow established calling procedures and document requests from property owners who do not wish to be contacted again.

Maintain a professional and friendly attitude throughout all calls.

Confident, friendly, and natural telephone manner.

Strong communication and active listening skills.

Ability to handle rejection, respond to basic objections, and keep conversations engaging without sounding robotic.

Good organizational skills and attention to detail.

Ability to follow scripts, instructions, and established calling procedures.

Reliable internet connection, a quality headset, and a quiet working environment.

Availability during agreed U.S. calling hours.

Hourly compensation based on experience and qualifications.



Applicants must indicate their expected hourly rate in USD.



Working hours and weekly schedule will be discussed with shortlisted candidates.

 include the following:

 message, please provide:

We specialize in creating modern, functional, and visually refined shelving solutions tailored to each customer's space, style, and requirements.



We are looking for a **Design Consultant with strong SketchUp and sales skills** who can guide clients from the initial consultation through design, proposal, follow-up, and final sale.



This role is ideal for someone who is **creative, proactive, detail-oriented, persuasive, client-focused, and comfortable taking ownership of the full customer journey**.



## Responsibilities



- Conduct virtual design and sales consultations with customers via Zoom or similar platforms.

- Build rapport with clients and confidently guide conversations from discovery through recommendation and next steps.

- Understand each client's goals, design preferences, dimensions, budget, timeline, and space constraints.

- Work with homeowners, designers, architects, and other B2B clients to understand project requirements and specifications.

- Use SketchUp to create accurate 3D models of custom shelving designs.

- Translate client ideas, reference images, floor plans, and measurements into practical design solutions.

- Present designs in a clear and compelling way that helps customers visualize the finished project.

- Recommend the best solution based on the client's needs while balancing design, functionality, budget, and company offerings.

- Prepare design proposals, quotations, specifications, and supporting sales materials.

- Confidently discuss pricing, options, upgrades, timelines, and next steps with customers.

- Address objections and concerns professionally and help clients make confident purchasing decisions.

- Follow up consistently with open opportunities to move projects toward approval and payment.

- Take ownership of closing sales rather than waiting for customers to follow up.

- Maintain accurate customer notes, deal stages, follow-up dates, and activity inside the CRM.

- Use the CRM to manage the sales pipeline and ensure no qualified opportunity is forgotten or left inactive.

- Create and complete follow-up tasks for every open opportunity.

- Re-engage clients who have received a proposal but have not yet made a decision.

- Revise designs based on client feedback while maintaining functionality, aesthetics, feasibility, and sales momentum.

- Ensure dimensions, configurations, and design details are accurate before projects move forward.

- Identify potential design or installation challenges before they become problems.

- Collaborate with sales, production, operations, and installation teams to ensure approved designs can be executed correctly.

- Communicate project details clearly to internal teams and ensure smooth handoff after the sale is completed.

- Maintain organized project files, SketchUp models, measurements, notes, quotations, and customer information.

- Stay current on modern interior design, shelving trends, materials, finishes, and space-planning best practices.



## What We're Looking For



- Strong proficiency in SketchUp.

- Proven sales or consultative selling experience.

- Confidence conducting customer-facing virtual meetings.

- Ability to lead a sales conversation rather than simply answer customer questions.

- Strong ability to build trust and rapport with customers remotely.

- Experience following up with leads and opportunities until a clear decision is reached.

- Comfortable asking for the sale and guiding customers toward the next step.

- Experience using a CRM to manage leads, opportunities, follow-ups, notes, and sales stages.

- Strong understanding of sales pipeline management and follow-up discipline.

- Experience creating accurate architectural, interior, furniture, cabinetry, or product-related 3D models.

- Strong spatial awareness and ability to visualize solutions within real-world spaces.

- Ability to interpret dimensions, floor plans, photos, sketches, and customer-provided measurements.

- Strong attention to proportion, scale, alignment, spacing, and overall visual balance.

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

- Ability to explain design decisions and technical details clearly to people without a design background.

- Strong listening skills and ability to uncover the client's true needs and priorities.

- Ability to manage multiple active customer projects and sales opportunities at different stages.

- Comfortable working independently in a fully remote environment.

- Strong organizational and time-management skills.

- A proactive mindset—you identify what needs to happen next and take action without waiting to be told.



## Preferred Skills



- Experience in interior design, architecture, furniture design, cabinetry, millwork, shelving, or a related field.

- Experience selling custom, premium, or high-ticket products and services.

- Experience with consultative or solution-based selling.

- Experience closing sales through virtual consultations.

- Experience working with both B2C and B2B clients.

- Experience working with architects, interior designers, contractors, or trade professionals.

- Experience with SketchUp rendering plugins or other rendering software.

- Familiarity with AutoCAD, Revit, Adobe Creative Suite, or similar design tools.

- Understanding of wall construction, mounting considerations, dimensions, tolerances, and installation constraints.

- Basic understanding of materials, finishes, manufacturing, and fabrication processes.

- Experience preparing quotations or estimating custom projects.

- Familiarity with CRM, project management, and remote collaboration tools.



## Measures of Success



- **Sales conversion:** Consistently convert qualified consultations and proposals into completed sales.

- **Follow-up discipline:** Ensure every active opportunity has a clear next step and scheduled follow-up in the CRM.

- **CRM accuracy:** Maintain complete and current customer notes, opportunity stages, quotations, follow-up dates, and communication history.

- **Pipeline management:** Keep opportunities moving and proactively address deals that have stalled.

- **Consultation quality:** Conduct professional virtual meetings that clearly identify the client's needs, budget, timeline, and decision criteria.

- **Closing ability:** Confidently guide customers toward a purchasing decision and directly ask for the sale when appropriate.

- **Proposal follow-through:** Consistently follow up after designs and quotations are sent rather than waiting for customers to respond.

- **Response speed:** Reply to new leads, customer questions, and follow-up opportunities promptly.

- **Design accuracy:** Produce SketchUp models with accurate dimensions, configurations, and specifications that can move forward with minimal corrections.

- **Design turnaround time:** Complete initial designs and revisions within agreed timelines without sacrificing quality.

- **Revision efficiency:** Reduce unnecessary back-and-forth by understanding customer requirements and producing strong initial concepts.

- **Customer satisfaction:** Maintain a high level of customer satisfaction through responsive communication, thoughtful recommendations, and professional design support.

- **Average order value:** Identify appropriate opportunities for upgrades, additional shelving, or better configurations that genuinely improve the customer's project.

- **Proactive problem solving:** Identify missing measurements, design conflicts, installation concerns, or sales obstacles before they delay the project.

- **Design quality:** Consistently create solutions that are functional, visually balanced, and aligned with the Modern Shelving aesthetic.

- **Internal handoff quality:** Provide production and installation teams with complete and understandable project information after the sale closes.

- **Project organization:** Maintain accurate, organized, and up-to-date files, drawings, notes, quotations, and customer records.

- **Ownership:** Manage assigned opportunities independently from initial consultation through close without requiring constant reminders from management.



## The Person We Want



We are looking for someone who is both a **designer and a salesperson**.



A strong Design Consultant should not simply create a design and send a quotation. You should take responsibility for helping the customer move from interest to decision.



You should be comfortable saying:



- "Based on what you've told me, this is the option I recommend."

- "Would you like to move forward with this design?"

- "I wanted to follow up on the proposal and see what is holding you back from moving forward."

- "I noticed we haven't heard back, so I wanted to reconnect and answer any remaining questions."

- "There is another configuration that may work better for your space and budget."

- "I'll follow up with you on this date so we can keep the project moving."

- "I identified a potential installation issue and updated the design before we proceed."



We value **initiative, design judgment, sales ability, follow-through, accuracy, responsiveness, customer service, and ownership**.



## Habits for Success



- Be proactive rather than waiting for instructions.

- Follow up until every qualified opportunity reaches a clear outcome.

- Always leave a client conversation with a defined next step.

- Update the CRM immediately after customer interactions.

- Never allow an active sales opportunity to sit without a follow-up date.

- Build trust by listening first and recommending the right solution.

- Ask for the sale confidently when the customer is ready.

- Double-check dimensions and details before submitting designs.

- Keep projects organized and communicate blockers early.

- Recommend solutions instead of simply identifying problems.

- Maintain a high standard for both design quality and customer experience.

- Continuously improve your SketchUp, design, sales, and product knowledge.



## Application Instructions



To confirm that you have read the full job description, include the code **DC-SKETCHUP** in your application.



Please be prepared to share:



- Your SketchUp portfolio or examples of 3D models you have created.

- Examples of interior, furniture, architectural, cabinetry, shelving, or related design work.

- Your experience conducting virtual client consultations.

- Your experience in sales, follow-up, and closing.

- The CRM systems you have used.

- An example of a sale you successfully moved from consultation through follow-up to close.

- An example of a time you proactively identified and solved a design or customer problem.

description:

About Inner Child



Inner Child is a design-led home decor and accessories brand built around delightful, high-quality artisanal products—think elevated, playful, and beautiful. We sell primarily DTC on Shopify and wholesale via Faire, and we run a fast-moving operation where details matter.



We’re looking for a sharp, reliable VA to own the daily operating rhythm across Shopify, Faire, customer experience, and general e-comm operations. This role is for someone who likes clean systems, takes initiative, and can keep an online store running smoothly without being chased.

Publish new products and update existing ones as inventory, packaging, or specs change



Create and QA discount codes and promotions (rules, stacking behavior, expiration)

2) Faire Wholesale Operations

Maintain Faire catalog: listings, pricing, case packs, lead times, inventory sync logic



Handle buyer messaging (fast, friendly, professional) and resolve issues



Support sampling, new account onboarding, and re-order workflows



Prepare weekly snapshots: orders, inquiries, best-sellers, and anything that needs attention



3) Customer Experience (CX) –
 First



Respond to customer
s and DMs with a warm, premium-brand voice



Handle common requests: shipping updates, order edits, returns/exchanges, product questions



Track and escalate exceptions: lost/damaged packages, wrong items, address issues



Maintain CX macros/templates and improve them over time (faster + more consistent)



4) Daily Operations & Admin



Coordinate with 3PL/warehouse: shipment issues, inventory checks, address corrections



Create/maintain simple trackers: backorders, replacements, damaged goods, open issues



Support basic reporting: daily order count, top SKUs, low stock, returns reasons, etc.



Keep operations organized: clean documentation, checklists, and “nothing falls through cracks” follow-through



What “Great” Looks Like



You are proactive and detail-obsessed (in a good way): you spot issues before customers do



You communicate clearly and don’t let tasks linger



You’re comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with lots of small moving parts



You like building systems: templates, checklists, trackers, and repeatable workflows



You can switch between creative brand polish and operational precision



Requirements



Hands-on experience with Shopify (product setup, collections, discounts, order basics)



Experience with Faire (preferred) or wholesale marketplace workflows



Strong written English and customer-facing professionalism



Extremely organized; comfortable managing multiple workstreams and deadlines



Comfortable with Google Sheets / Excel and lightweight reporting



Bonus: Klaviyo basics, Google Merchant Center familiarity, or Shopify apps (reviews, bundles, inventory tools)



Tools We Use (or similar)



Shopify, Faire, Gmail, Google Sheets/Docs, Canva, Excel (optional: Klaviyo, Slack, project tracker like Notion/Trello/Asana)



How to Apply



Please include:



A short intro and why this role fits you



Your Shopify + Faire experience (specific examples)



Your availability (hours/week) and timezone



Your hourly rate (or monthly retainer)



A brief example of how you’d reply to this customer message:

“Hi! I ordered 6 days ago and haven’t seen tracking update. Can you help?”



Optional but appreciated: a screenshot/list of stores you’ve supported or a short Loom walkthrough of similar work

title: ROCK-STAR SALES REP | $10–$30+/HR EARNING POTENTIAL | FULL-TIME REMOTE
description:
We are looking for a top 3–5% caliber salesperson with exceptional integrity.



If you have consistently been one of the strongest salespeople on your team, love closing deals, take pride in representing a high-quality service you genuinely believe in, and can point to measurable results that prove your ability, we want to hear from you.



This is not an entry-level sales position and not a customer-service/order-taking role. We are looking for someone who is exceptionally persuasive, organized, competitive, and disciplined about follow-up—but who also believes that integrity and doing what is right for the customer come before commissions.



We want a salesperson who can sell at a very high level without compromising honesty or trust. The goal isn't to pressure people into buying something they don't need. It's to help customers understand the value of a high-quality service, confidently recommend the right solution, and earn their business.



THE ROLE

You will primarily handle warm inbound leads from customers already interested in our services and turn those opportunities into booked jobs.



Services include windshield replacement, rock chip repair, automotive window tint, and headlight restoration.



The position may also include outbound business development, primarily working warm leads and opportunities with fleets, dealerships, and automotive businesses.



Your job is to maximize every lead: build trust quickly, identify what the customer needs, handle objections, confidently ask for the sale, keep excellent notes, and follow up at exactly the right times.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Exceptional sales ability. Ideally, you have measurable evidence that you've been among the top performers in a previous sales organization.



Exceptional integrity. You sell honestly, keep your word, put the customer's best interests first, and never sacrifice integrity for a commission.



Near-native spoken English. Your English must be exceptionally fluent, natural, and effortless for U.S. customers to understand over the phone.



Excellent organization and follow-up. You reliably track opportunities, maintain accurate notes, and don't let valuable leads fall through the cracks.



Omega EDI experience is preferred, but not required.



GoHighLevel experience is a plus, but not required.



Auto glass or automotive tint sales experience is preferred, but not required.



We would rather hire an exceptional salesperson with integrity and teach them auto glass than hire someone with years of industry experience who is only average at sales.



COMPENSATION

A successful salesperson will have the opportunity to earn approximately $10–$30+ USD/hour in total compensation. Exceptional performers may earn more.



Starting base: approximately $5–$6 USD/hour, depending on experience and demonstrated ability, plus uncapped commissions and performance bonuses.



This is a full-time position, with meaningful availability required during U.S. Mountain Time business hours.



International applicants are welcome.



HOW TO APPLY

Please send your résumé/work history and measurable evidence of your sales performance.



Tell us what you sold, your results, quota performance, awards, and—where possible—your ranking compared with other salespeople.



For example: “I ranked #2 out of 47 sales representatives and averaged 138% of quota.”



60-SECOND VOICE AUDITION

Send us a 60-second voice recording selling yourself to us.



Imagine you have just one minute to convince us that you're the exceptional salesperson we're looking for.



Don't just tell us you're great at sales. Sell us on why we should hire you.



We want to hear your natural communication style, confidence, personality, and ability to persuade.



Be authentic, compelling, and memorable. Make us want to hire you!



Also tell us:

• Where you're located

• What hours you can work in U.S. Mountain Time

• Your best measurable sales achievement

• Whether you've used Omega EDI

• Whether you have experience with GoHighLevel

• Whether you've sold auto glass or automotive tint

• What total compensation would make this opportunity attractive to you



Please do not apply without the voice recording and measurable information about your sales performance.



We're looking for someone who wants more than just a paycheck, someone who wants to make a meaningful difference in people's lives. We're building a company that is committed to giving back generously to the community, with a long-term goal of donating 100% of our profits to charitable causes, so even beyond helping the people you talk with on the phone, your success will help us make an even greater positive impact in the world.
