title: Loan Processor / Lending Operations Coordinator
description:
We are a U.S.-based private money lending company that provides short-term, asset-based loans to real estate investors. We focus on first- and second-position loans, bridge funding, gap funding, and creative real estate transactions.

We value clean execution, capital protection, and professional communication.



Role Overview

We are hiring a Loan Processor / Lending Operations Coordinator to run borrower intake, manage our loan pipeline, and prepare deal files for underwriting. This role is the operational backbone of our lending business and works directly with borrowers, brokers, and internal leadership.



This is not a bank mortgage role. You will support private money and creative real estate deals using a CRM pipeline (GoHighLevel) and documented internal SOPs.



Key Responsibilities



Borrower Intake & Pipeline Management

Respond to new borrower applications and CRM inquiries the same business day

Send first-touch outreach to all new borrower leads promptly

Follow up consistently to collect missing application items

Accurately track and update borrower status through the correct CRM pipeline stages

Keep the pipeline clean — no stale files, no unanswered leads

Flag urgent or high-priority deals for leadership without delay





Loan File Organization & Documentation

Create and maintain borrower folders in Google Drive per company naming conventions

Collect ALL required documents before escalating a file: purchase agreement, rehab budget/scope of work, ARV comps, property photos, borrower ID, LLC documents (Operating Agreement + proof of good standing), verified HUDs, insurance, and a clearly stated exit strategy

Track all documents and file status accurately in the CRM

Submit complete, clearly labeled files that are ready for underwriting





SOP Adherence & Deal Pre-Qualification

Pre-qualify deals against our lending criteria before escalating (private money vs. hard money vs. hybrid)

Apply our quick-screen criteria accurately (LTV, borrower spread, combined leverage, close timeline)

Verify all non-negotiable borrower requirements

Route deals that fall outside our criteria to our referral process per SOP

Escalate unclear or borderline deals to leadership — never force a file through



Communication & Reporting



Provide consistent daily end-of-day (EOD) updates: completed, pending, needs attention

Communicate professionally and clearly with borrowers throughout the loan process

Proactively surface open loops, urgent items, and potential issues without being asked

Log all borrower conversations and decisions in the CRM accurately and promptly



Important Authority Boundaries



You will prepare, organize, and pre-qualify deals — but you will not approve loans, set terms, or make funding decisions. All approvals and final decisions stay with internal leadership.

Requirements



2+ years experience in real estate transactions, loan processing, or lending support

Strong attention to detail and organization

Excellent written and spoken English

Comfortable communicating with U.S.-based clients

Ability to manage multiple deals at once without dropping follow-ups

Experience using CRMs and pipeline-based systems

Reliable daily availability and consistent EOD reporting



Nice to Have (Not Required)



Private money, hard money, or creative real estate (subject-to, seller finance) experience

Familiarity with real estate investing terminology and underwriting basics (ARV, LTV, HUDs, exit strategy)

Experience pulling comps (e.g., PropStream, Redfin)

GoHighLevel or similar CRM experience



What Success Looks Like



Clean, accurate CRM records with every lead answered

Deals move smoothly with minimal rework

Files reach leadership complete and ready for underwriting

Borrowers feel informed and supported

Leadership does not need to fix or chase files



Growth Path



Strong performers move into expanded responsibility: full pipeline management without daily supervision, loan-file audits, lead generation in investor communities, weekly pipeline and loan-admin reporting, and coordinating document requests with borrowers and title companies.



How to Apply



Please submit your resume along with a brief introduction explaining your relevant experience and why you're an excellent fit for this role. Include the word "Lending" in your application message so we know you read this fully.

title: Funnel Specialist
description:
About The Visionary Group (TVG)



Welcome to The Visionary Group. We are a close knit e-commerce growth team of brand builders, strategists, and marketers. We help companies scale to maximum their true potential by exploring DTC solutions best suit for their stage of business. Founded in 2022, our collection of fast paced tea
mbers is becoming filled with high priority work, which is where you come in!



What this position is responsible for:



We’re looking for a highly analytical and execution-focused DTC Funnel Optimization Specialist who can identify conversion bottlenecks, implement high-impact fixes, and continuously improve the customer journey across our eCommerce client portfolio. This role exists to bridge the gap between paid acquisition and on-site conversion performance, ensuring traffic generated by our Paid Media Strategists converts at the highest possible rate. You’ll own the diagnosis, testing, implementation, and reporting of funnel improvements while helping scale winning conversion strategies across multiple brands.



Requirements/Experience:



- 2+ years of experience in Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO), DTC eCommerce, funnel optimization, or Shopify growth operations



- Strong working knowledge of Shopify and DTC customer acquisition funnels



- Experience using tools such as GA4, Triple Whale, Shopify Analytics, Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, or similar analytics platforms



- Hands-on experience building and updating landing pages and pre-sale pages using Replo or similar no-code builders



- Familiarity with quiz funnel platforms such as Octane AI, Shop Quiz, TryNow, or related tools



- Experience implementing and analyzing A/B tests using tools like Convert, GLO, Intelligems, or equivalent testing platforms



- Strong understanding of key eCommerce conversion metrics including LP CVR, PDP CVR, ATC rate, checkout completion rate, AOV, and funnel conversion flow



- Ability to write high-converting CRO-focused copy including headlines, CTAs, benefit-driven bullets, and trust-building messaging



- Strong analytical thinking with the ability to prioritize opportunities based on impact and effort



- Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple client funnels simultaneously



- Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with Paid Media Strategists and internal stakeholders



- High attention to detail and strong bias toward execution and accountability



- Comfortable working in a fast-paced, performance-driven remote environment



Roles & Responsibilities for this position:



- Conduct monthly audits of each client’s full acquisition funnel, including the transition from ad creative to landing page/PDP, add-to-cart flow, checkout experience, and post-purchase confirmation journey



- Analyze funnel performance data using GA4, Triple Whale, Shopify Analytics, Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, and related tools to identify drop-off points, friction areas, and conversion opportunities



- Develop and maintain a prioritized “funnel fix queue” for each client based on projected revenue lift, implementation effort, and business impact



- Collaborate closely with Paid Media Strategists to identify and communicate systemic funnel issues, including disconnects between ad messaging and landing page experience



- Build, launch, and optimize pre-sale pages in Replo to support paid acquisition campaigns and improve conversion performance



- Create, update, and maintain quiz funnels using tools such as Octane AI, Shop Quiz, TryNow, and similar platforms

Implement updates to product detail pages (PDPs) using Shopify-native apps and templated modules without requiring custom Liquid development



- Launch and optimize landing pages designed specifically for paid traffic campaigns and conversion-focused customer journeys



- Execute structured A/B testing initiatives using platforms such as Convert, GLO, or Intelligems, ensuring proper setup, tracking, and reporting



- Write and refine conversion-focused copy for headlines, subheads, product bullets, CTAs, badges, and other on-site conversion elements



- Run a minimum of two A/B tests per client each month, continuously iterating based on performance insights and learnings



- Maintain a centralized testing log documenting hypotheses, variants, results, learnings, and next-step recommendations across all client accounts



- Identify winning conversion patterns and scalable best practices, then templatize and implement them across the broader client portfolio



- Own and monitor core funnel performance metrics including landing page CVR, PDP CVR, ATC rate, checkout completion rate, AOV, quiz completion rate, and quiz-to-purchase rate



- Provide weekly funnel performance updates and actionable insights to Paid Media Strategists via Slack



- Contribute funnel performance insights and scorecard data to monthly client reporting deliverables



- Take full ownership of implementation timelines, optimization initiatives, and measurable funnel performance improvements across assigned accounts



Notes:

- Must be available to work CST hours

- ASAP hire - immediate availability preferred

- Must be based in the Philippines



Apply now!

title: QuickBooks Accounting & Product Specialist
description:
Please read in it's entirety. AI responses will be deleted. We can tell who does not read this job description.. IF you are really interested, please apply.



1 Dash is seeking an experienced **QuickBooks and accounting professional** to help us test, evaluate, and improve an accounting-focused software platform currently under development.



This is not a traditional bookkeeping position.



We are looking for someone who understands how businesses actually use QuickBooks and accounting software and can apply that experience from a **product and workflow perspective**.



You will spend approximately four hours per day actively working inside our software, creating realistic accounting scenarios, testing workflows, identifying problems or inefficiencies, and recommending improvements to our development team.



Your accounting expertise will directly influence how the product is designed and how its accounting functionality works.



## What You'll Do



Your primary responsibility will be to act as an accounting and QuickBooks subject-matter expert for our software development team.



You will:



- Spend approximately **4 hours per day actively testing the software**

- Create realistic businesses, transactions, accounts, customers, vendors, invoices, payments, expenses, and other accounting scenarios

- Evaluate how the software handles common accounting workflows

- Compare workflows and functionality with QuickBooks and accounting best practices

- Review the current accounting structure and recommend better ways to organize or configure the system

- Identify missing accounting features or functionality

- Identify workflows that are unnecessarily complicated or confusing

- Look for accounting situations that could create inaccurate financial reporting

- Test new features and updates released by the development team

- Document bugs, accounting issues, and unexpected behavior

- Recommend functional and workflow improvements

- Explain accounting requirements to developers who may not have an accounting background

- Work directly with our development and leadership teams to prioritize improvements

- Help determine how accounting information should be presented to business owners who may not be accounting experts



## Examples of What You May Review



You may be asked to test and provide recommendations regarding:



- Chart of Accounts structure

- Bank and credit card transactions

- Transaction categorization

- Bank reconciliation

- Accounts receivable

- Accounts payable

- Invoicing and payments

- Customer credits and refunds

- Vendor bills and expenses

- Deposits

- Transfers

- Journal entries

- Recurring transactions

- Financial reporting

- Profit & Loss statements

- Balance Sheets

- Cash-flow reporting

- General Ledger activity

- Sales tax workflows

- Month-end accounting procedures

- Accounting controls and audit trails

- User permissions and accounting controls

- QuickBooks import/export or integration workflows

- Overall ease of use for small-business owners



## What We're Looking For



The ideal candidate has **strong hands-on QuickBooks experience combined with a solid understanding of accounting principles.**



You should be comfortable looking at a software workflow and saying:



*"This technically works, but this isn't how an accountant or business owner would expect it to work. Here's how we should change it."*



### Preferred Qualifications



- 5+ years of hands-on accounting or bookkeeping experience

- Advanced QuickBooks Online experience

- Strong understanding of GAAP and general accounting principles

- Experience managing books for multiple businesses or clients

- Experience with month-end close and financial statement preparation

- Strong understanding of real-world small-business accounting workflows

- Ability to identify accounting errors and unusual financial results

- Comfortable learning and testing new software

- Able to clearly document problems and recommended solutions

- Comfortable communicating directly with software developers



**QuickBooks ProAdvisor certification is strongly preferred.**



CPA certification is welcome but **not required**. Practical QuickBooks and accounting experience is more important for this position.



## What Makes This Role Different



This position sits between **accounting and software product development**.



You will not simply be entering transactions or reconciling accounts. You will be helping determine **how accounting software should work.**



We want someone who enjoys asking questions such as:



- Is there a better way to handle this transaction?

- Would this workflow make sense to an accountant?

- Would a small-business owner understand this?

- What happens if the user makes a mistake?

- Does this transaction flow correctly through the financial statements?

- What accounting functionality are we missing?

- How does QuickBooks handle this, and could we make the experience better?



Your recommendations will be reviewed directly by our development team and may become part of the product.



## Schedule



This is a **part-time position requiring approximately 4 hours per day**.



We are looking for someone who can consistently dedicate focused time to testing the platform rather than occasionally reviewing features.



## Ideal Candidate



This role would be especially well suited for an experienced **QuickBooks ProAdvisor, accountant, senior bookkeeper, fractional controller, or accounting consultant** who enjoys technology and would like to help shape the development of a new software platform.



If you have ever used accounting software and thought, *"There has to be a better way to do this,"* this may be an excellent fit.



Please provide a loom video stating why you would be a good candidate for this role.

title: Financial Controller
description:
**Own the accounting. Help build what comes next.**



We're a growing US-based, technology-enabled services business looking for an experienced Financial Controller to lead hands-on accounting across three related entities.



You'll take ownership of the books, establish dependable reporting, and strengthen the processes behind the numbers. You'll also work directly with business and technical leadership to improve systems and reduce unnecessary manual work.



This role suits someone who brings controller-level accounting judgment, enjoys solving problems, and communicates clearly. You should be comfortable doing the detailed work while helping build an accounting function that can grow with the business.



**What you'll own**



- **Multi-entity accounting:** Maintain accurate books, reconciliations, and intercompany balances across three related businesses.

- **Monthly close and reporting:** Establish a consistent close process and deliver timely financial statements with clear explanations of results.

- **Day-to-day financial operations:** Manage invoicing, accounts receivable, accounts payable, and payment preparation within appropriate approval processes.

- **Fee and payment accounting:** Ensure customer-specific pricing and payment arrangements are accurately reflected in the books.

- **Cash visibility:** Maintain practical cash forecasts and flag cash needs, unusual balances, and discrepancies early.

- **Processes and controls:** Document workflows, strengthen financial safeguards, and make recurring work more reliable.

- **Systems improvement:** Partner with technical leadership to identify automation opportunities, explain accounting requirements, and verify that improvements work correctly.

- **External coordination:** Prepare organized records and work with outside tax and accounting advisers as needed.



You'll stay involved in the daily work while improving how it gets done.



**What you bring**



- Controller-level skills and experience, shown through meaningful ownership of accounting, monthly close, and financial reporting.

- Strong knowledge of accrual accounting and experience supporting US-based businesses.

- Advanced QuickBooks Online proficiency.

- Experience managing multiple entities, including intercompany transactions and reconciliations.

- Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills.

- Excellent spoken and written English. You can participate confidently in live discussions, write clear updates, ask precise questions, and explain financial issues to non-accountants.

- The ability to investigate discrepancies, work through incomplete information, and recognize when an issue needs clarification or escalation.

- Availability to work a consistent schedule aligned with US business hours, with some flexibility in start and end times.

- A reliable remote-work setup, stable internet, and a practical backup plan.



Experience improving accounting processes, handling complex billing arrangements, or working with software integrations and automation is especially valuable.



**How you work**



- **You follow through.** You keep priorities moving, meet commitments, and surface problems early.

- **You exercise sound judgment.** You investigate before drawing conclusions, document important assumptions, and make unresolved issues visible.

- **You look for practical improvements.** You notice recurring problems and help fix the process behind them.

- **You protect accuracy.** You welcome better tools while maintaining appropriate review, approvals, and accountability.

- **You stay hands-on.** You're comfortable reconciling a difficult account, preparing reports, and discussing improvements with leadership.



**Your first 90 days**



You'll develop a clear understanding of the entities, books, and transaction flows. You'll identify the most important gaps and agree on priorities with leadership.



From there, you'll establish a dependable close and reporting routine, improve cash visibility, document core workflows, and begin implementing practical improvements. Priorities and timing will reflect the condition of the books and the resources available.



**Why join us**



- **Meaningful ownership:** Help shape how the accounting function operates.

- **Direct collaboration:** Work closely with business and technical decision-makers.

- **Practical use of technology:** Help turn recurring manual work into reliable processes.

- **Room to grow:** Develop your responsibilities as the business and accounting function evolve.

- **Fully remote work:** Work from the Philippines with a consistent, agreed schedule.



**Schedule and compensation**



- **Location:** Remote, Philippines.

- **Commitment:** Full-time.

- **Schedule:** US business hours, with a couple of hours of flexibility in start and end times. We'll agree on a consistent schedule during hiring that supports regular collaboration with the US team. This generally means evening and overnight work in the Philippines.

- **Compensation:** Based on experience, accounting capability, and scope of responsibility. Please include your expected monthly compensation in PHP.



**How to apply**



Use this subject line:



**Application – Financial Controller – [Your Full Name]**



We may not review applications that don't use this subject line.



Your
 should include the following.



**1. Résumé (PDF)**

List your accounting roles, the entities and industries you supported, and the systems you used.



**2. Video introduction (2–3 minutes)**

Record a short video and share it as a link through Loom, Google Drive, or an unlisted YouTube video. Make sure anyone with the link can view it. In the video, cover:

- Who you are and your current or most recent role

- The controller-level work you've owned for a US-based business

- Your experience with QuickBooks Online and multi-entity accounting

- Why this role interests you



Please speak naturally rather than reading from a script. We want to hear how you explain things.



**3. Written answers to these questions**

- What accounting functions have you personally owned for a US-based business?

- Describe your QuickBooks Online and multi-entity accounting experience.

- Share one accounting process you improved. What did you change, and how did you verify the result?

- Describe how you resolved incomplete records or a difficult reconciliation.

- Confirm your availability for US business hours, your preferred working hours, your expected monthly compensation in PHP, and your earliest start date.



We won't consider incomplete applications, including those missing the video link or the written answers.



Shortlisted candidates may complete a practical accounting exercise and discuss their approach in a live interview.



We're looking for someone who makes the numbers dependable, communicates clearly, and helps the business operate better.

title: Bathroom Vanity Designer — Modern Concepts & Product Development
description:
We are a bathroom vanity manufacturer looking for a talented, experienced designer to help us create a distinctive collection of modern vanities for both everyday and higher-end homeowners.

• Include reference images and brief notes explaining each concept.



Your focus will be creative design. We have a separate person handling CAD, technical drawings, and manufacturing files.

EXPERIENCE WE’RE LOOKING FOR

• A strong portfolio demonstrating your own design ability.

• An understanding of what makes a design attractive, functional, and practical to manufacture.

• The ability to contribute fresh ideas independently and work with feedback.

Relevant examples of previous work are required.

Location: Remote

description:
We are an AI-powered social media content agency creating videos, virtual influencers and branded content for businesses. We are looking for an experienced AI Content Creator & Social Media Manager who can take content from idea to finished post.



THE ROLE

You will manage content production and posting for 3-5 client brands, creating and publishing one original piece of content per client per day (3-5 pieces daily in total). Content will primarily include short-form AI videos, AI influencer/UGC-style content and supporting image posts for Instagram, TikTok and other agreed platforms. Plan and batch content in advance to maintain a consistent daily schedule.



RESPONSIBILITIES

- Research each client's audience, competitors and relevant social media trends.

- Develop content calendars, ideas, hooks, scripts and storyboards tailored to each brand.

- Generate high-quality AI images and videos, maintaining consistent characters, products and brand identity across posts.

- Create and manage AI influencer identities; experience with Higgsfield and Soul IDs is strongly preferred.

- Edit finished content with natural pacing, captions, voiceovers, sound effects and music using tools such as CapCut, Premiere Pro or similar.

- Write engaging captions and calls to action, format content for each platform, and schedule/publish approved posts.

- Follow our approval process: obtain approval for concepts/scripts and finished content before publishing.

- Check every asset for visual glitches, unnatural movement, inaccurate text, character inconsistencies and brand errors.

- Keep client assets, prompts, project files and content calendars organised.

- Track performance and provide a concise weekly report with practical recommendations for improvement.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

- Proven hands-on experience creating AI-generated content, supported by a portfolio. This is not an entry-level AI training role.

- Strong short-form video editing, storytelling and prompt-writing skills.

- Experience managing social media content and publishing schedules for brands or clients.

- Ability to manage multiple client brands, meet deadlines and maintain quality at the required daily volume.

- Good written English, attention to detail and clear communication.

- Reliable internet access and a computer suitable for video editing.

- Understanding of responsible AI use, including permission to use people's likenesses and appropriate use of music and other assets.



STRONGLY PREFERRED

- Practical experience with Higgsfield, Soul IDs and consistent AI characters/influencers.

- Experience producing realistic AI UGC, product videos and social media ads.

- Experience using other AI image/video and voice tools, and adapting quickly to new workflows.



HOW TO APPLY

Please include:

1. A brief introduction and summary of your relevant experience.

2. Links to 3-5 examples of AI content you personally created, including short-form videos. Explain your contribution and which tools you used.

3. Details of your experience with Higgsfield, Soul IDs and maintaining character consistency.

4. Your approach to planning and delivering one daily post for each of 3-5 clients.

5. Your availability, expected monthly compensation and which tools/subscriptions you currently use.



We value strong creative judgment, consistent execution and content that feels engaging and natural. We are looking for someone who can take ownership of production while working closely with us on strategy and approvals.

title: Media Buyer Specialist (PH)

PH - Media Buyer Specialist



We're looking for a Media Buyer Specialist to own the performance and impact of a large book of complex, custom paid media campaigns for our practices — leading strategy, setup, optimization, and communication with practices and cross-functional teams to get results.



You'll also be stepping into using AI as leverage — scaling both the quality and volume of your work by recognizing patterns, making good bets, and playing to exploit every advantage, rather than relying on automated platforms or SOPs to do the thinking for you.



Ad buying is changing fast. This role exists for someone who understands data, tracking, and the full funnel deeply enough to know when to follow our best practices and when to trust their own judgment — and who's ready to own the outcome either way. Getting this right lets the rest of our media team focus on their own work instead of constantly course-correcting an underperforming book.



Our objectives for the role

- Own the performance of a large, complex book of campaigns, around 50 initially and scales up with time — from strategy and setup through optimization — and be accountable for the outcome, whether you followed our playbooks or your own judgment to get there.

- Build deep command of our reporting and tracking systems so you can pull your own data, diagnose account health quickly and accurately, and manage risk proactively before it shows up in results.

- Use AI as leverage to run more accounts at a higher level — treating media buying as a competitive game of pattern recognition, hypothesis-driven testing, and educated bets – to drive results you’ll own.

- Contribute best practices and workflows — like a new setup approach or AI-assisted process — that get adopted as standard team practice.

- Use your understanding of the full funnel we deploy and your excellent communication skills to influence clients and cross-functional teams towards better performance for the campaigns you own.



We're looking for:

- Ownership and accountability — you take full responsibility for a large book of accounts' results, regardless of whether you followed an SOP or your own judgment to get there.

- Autonomy and judgment — you know when to lean on established playbooks and when to deviate, and you're comfortable making that call independently.

- Optimization and testing rigor — you approach media buying like a competitive game: pattern recognition, hypothesis-driven tests, and educated bets, not guesswork.

- Tracking and reporting command — you can pull your own data and diagnose account and tracking health quickly, without waiting on someone else to hand you a report.

- Productive use of AI — you use AI to scale the volume and quality of your work, but you don't let it replace your own judgment on what actually moves the needle.

Our objectives for the role

- Own creative performance (CTR, hook rate, thumb-stop/hold rate, cost per result) across your designs – and turn patterns of performance into meaningful insights and repeatable elements or frameworks that get actioned in feedback loops into your work and the broader team.

- Scale a creative process or workflow into standard team practice, and act as a subject-matter expert whose creative-performance patterns guide the rest of the team.



We're looking for:

Why Join us?

title: AI Content Creator, Storytelling (Remote, Full Time)
description:
AI Content Creator, Storytelling (Remote, Full Time)



At Brisby Media, we build and run creator communities for brands. Part of that is an AI creator community that teaches people how to make AI content that sells. We find people who want to get good at it, train them, and put them to work on real brands.



We are looking for 2 to 3 AI Content Creators to join our team. You make long, high quality AI story videos that sell our AI creator community. Every video you make shows people what is possible with the tools we teach, and makes them want to learn it.



The Opportunity: stories that sell a community



Most AI content is short and forgettable. We want stories. Videos up to 10 minutes long that people watch to the end, with a real story, a real voice and a reason to join. You make 60 or more of these finished pieces, and the best ones become our ads.



Why This Role Stands Out



• You make the flagship content. Your videos are the front door to the whole community.

• Long form is your playground. Up to 10 minutes per story, not 15-second clips.

• You see the result. We tell you which videos bring in members and which ones become ads.



What You'll Do



• Make 60 or more high quality AI videos, most of them storytelling videos, some up to 10 minutes long.

• Write the story first: the hook, the arc, the payoff, and why someone should join at the end.

• Use your own accounts and tools: Seedance, Omni, CapCut and whatever else you need to get the quality.

• Voice and edit the full piece so it is ready to post and ready to run as an ad.

• Turn each long story into short cuts for TikTok, Reels and Shorts.

• Report what you made: every finished piece, where it went, and how it did.



Who You Are



• You have made AI video that people watched to the end. Show us the long ones.

• A storyteller first. You know how to keep someone watching for 10 minutes, not 10 seconds.

• You already pay for your own tools and you know which one to use for which shot.

• Fast and consistent. You can hold quality across 60 pieces, not just one.

• Excellent written and spoken English. You understand English very well, you write natural scripts, and you can voice or direct a voice that sounds native.

• AI native. You use AI every day to write faster, review faster and find angles.



Bonus Points (not required)



• You have gone viral with AI story content.

• You have made AI videos that sold a course, a community or a product.

• You have edited YouTube long form.

• You know how to make an AI character stay the same across a whole video.



Application Questions



1. Send 3 AI videos you made, at least one longer than 3 minutes. For each one: the views, the tools you used, and how long it took.

2. Pitch a 5-minute story that would make someone want to learn AI video. The hook, the 3 beats, and the ending, in 100 words.

3. Which tools do you pay for today, and what do you use each one for?

4. How many finished AI videos did you make last month?

title: Junior Virtual Assistant - Creators & Community (Full Training, No Experience Needed)
description:
Do you scroll Instagram and always notice which videos make you stop - and wonder why? Then this could be your job.



We are a fast-growing Danish e-commerce company behind KidsBuddy, a smartwatch for kids that gives children freedom without a smartphone and gives parents peace of mind. Our best-performing ads are made by real Danish parents and UGC creators, and we're building a creator community around that. We're looking for a Junior Virtual Assistant to help run it, working closely with our founder. No experience needed - we will train you in everything.



WHO WE ARE

We are a small, fully remote team working closely together every day in Slack. We have a weekly team meeting where everyone joins, and despite the distance it feels like a real team - people help each other, celebrate wins together, and nobody is left alone with a problem. Several of our team members are based in the Philippines and have been with us for a long time.



We have high expectations and we're honest about that - but we match them with stable long-term work and a leader who invests time in helping you grow.



WHAT THE ROLE IS

Most of your day will be spent with our creators: finding them, persuading them, motivating them and helping them make great videos. Alongside that, you'll support the founder with operational tasks. As you prove yourself, more responsibility comes your way, and if you perform well there's a real path to owning our entire creator program.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Creators & community

- Find new UGC creators on Instagram and Trybe and persuade them to join our program

- Share new briefs and winning hooks and angles with creators, and keep them making more videos

- Review submitted videos against the brief and give clear, kind feedback

- Learn which videos, hooks and angles perform in our ads, and help turn that into better briefs

- Build a real creator community: group chats, broadcasts, recognition and small rewards

- Support our influencer partnerships with coordination, follow-ups and tracking

- Deliver approved content to our ads agency every day



Founder support & operations

- Follow up on tasks for the founder and make sure things get done

- Coordinate with suppliers and partners and keep ClickUp, our tracker and your daily EOD report updated

- Use AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, automations) to work faster and smarter



WHO YOU ARE

- Your English is excellent, written and spoken. This is the most important requirement.

- You know Instagram inside out: DMs, stories, reels and how creators think

- You are naturally persuasive - you enjoy turning a "maybe" into a "yes" without being pushy

- You are curious about why some videos perform and others don't

- You are comfortable using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) to write natural messages in Danish

- You take ownership, pay attention to details, and follow processes carefully

- When something is unclear, you try, you Google, you use AI, and then you ask smart questions

- You have reliable internet and backup power

- Experience with social media, influencers or UGC is a plus, but not required. Attitude is everything.



WHAT YOU'LL GET

- Full paid training on our creator program, Trybe and our creative process

- Working closely with the founder and learning how real e-commerce ads are made

- Hands-on experience with AI tools that most virtual assistants never get to use

- A friendly, supportive team that always has your back

- $4-8/hour starting pay with real raises when you deliver

- Christmas bonus every year

- A real path to owning our entire creator program



WORKING HOURS

Full-time, 40 hours/week. Your schedule is flexible, but at least 6 of your hours must fall between 8 AM and 5 PM Danish time, and you must be logged in no later than 9 AM Danish time every weekday. Denmark switches between summer and winter time, so in Philippine time that means logging in by 3 PM during Danish summer time (end of March to end of October) and by 4 PM during Danish winter time. If you are currently studying, your classes must not overlap with these hours.

The trial period is paid. You get full training in your first weeks.

title: Editorial Director, Field Nine Group
description:
We are *only* accepting applications here: 



About Field Nine Group

Field Nine Group is a Boston-based holding company that builds strategy, design, technology and creator partnerships for universities, foundations, media companies and national organizations. Our portfolio includes Adriana Lacy Consulting, our strategy, research and advisory practice; Channel Nine Studio, our design and development studio; Influencer Journalism and Verified Storytellers, which connect institutions with vetted creators; and two software products, InsightFlow and Social Chime. 



About the role

We've done a lot of work we're proud of over the past three years, and we've told almost no one about it. We have case studies that haven't been written, conference talks sitting unedited on YouTube, press coverage we never shared, and websites that undersell what we do. This role exists to fix that.



As our first Editorial Director, you'll own how Field Nine tells its story across every brand in the portfolio and across every channel where we show up. You'll write, edit, commission and publish, and you'll d
 what belongs where. This is a full-time role with a real backlog waiting on day one.



What you'll do

— Write case studies across the portfolio. You'll interview the team, dig through project history, and turn it into narrative stories about the thinking behind the work.

— Run the weekly Influencer Journalism newsletter from story selection through send.

— Ghostwrite for our founder, Adriana Lacy, including her Field Notes newsletter, thought leadership pieces, and LinkedIn and social posts, working from her voice notes, outlines and talks. Everything published under her name is reviewed by her before it goes out.

— Build the Field Nine Group site into a full company newsroom, with news, product updates, cross-portfolio stories, and coverage of our work around the world.

— Lead the content side of our upcoming Channel Nine Studio and Field Nine Group website redesigns, working with our design partner on site structure and page copy.

— Run social media for our own brands: Field Nine Group, Adriana Lacy Consulting, Channel Nine Studio and Influencer Journalism. You'll plan the calendar, write the copy, brief our designers on graphics, and schedule and publish posts.

Publish to Ghost and our websites, and turn talks, press mentions and finished projects into posts, clips and newsletter items.

— Clear the backlog in your first months, including press mentions, recorded talks and past projects that never got written up.

— Serve as backup for our client social media lead when she's out.

— Over time, work with our product team on updates and roadmap communications for InsightFlow and Social Chime.



Who we're looking for

You're a writer before anything else, and you can show us writing you're proud of, whether that's published articles, ghostwritten work, client case studies, a newsletter or a blog of your own. Published work is a plus but not a requirement. You can write convincingly in someone else's voice. You know how to interview people and turn messy notes into a clean story. You have good judgment about what's worth publishing, and you'll tell us when something isn't. You write fluently for American readers, you can run an editorial and social calendar without being chased, and you're comfortable in tools like Ghost, WordPress, Canva, Google Docs and social scheduling platforms. Experience at a newsroom, publication, agency or B2B technology company is a strong plus.



On AI

We use AI tools at Field Nine, and you're welcome to use them for research, transcription and organizing your notes. We're hiring you for your writing, though, and drafts that read like generic AI output won't work here. Our application process is designed to tell the difference.



Schedule and compensation

This is a full-time, remote contractor role. You'll need to work US Eastern business hours, which is an overnight shift in the Philippines, so you can collaborate with the team in real time. Compensation starts at $800 USD per month, with a rate review after 90 days.



How to apply

Apply only through our application form at 
.

Applications sent by
 or direct message won't be considered. Shortlisted candidates will complete a short, paid writing assignment.

title: Business Development Representative (BDR/SDR)
description:
Join a Winning Team with Real Opportunities for Success!



We're an established U.S. estate planning law firm with a growing portfolio of businesses, including an exciting new DIY estate planning platform.



Our marketing team has already achieved some impressive milestones, and now we're expanding our Business Development team to capitalize on the opportunities we've created.



We already have established relationships and plenty of low-hanging fruit that can translate into early wins. We're looking for a motivated, personable BDR/SDR who can help us turn those opportunities into long-term business partnerships and revenue.



This is not a high-pressure, cold-calling-only position. It's a relationship-driven business development role with significant growth potential.



What You'll Be Doing



Your primary responsibility will be developing and strengthening relationships with businesses in industries closely connected to estate planning.



Key responsibilities:



Reach out to existing business relationships and referral partners.



Identify and connect with new potential institutional partners.



Build relationships with financial advisors, insurance companies, financial services organizations, and other complementary businesses.



Introduce our established law firm and new DIY estate planning platform to potential partners.



Schedule partnership meetings, presentations, and follow-up calls.



Identify opportunities for referral programs, affiliate partnerships, and strategic collaborations.



Maintain consistent communication with partners to encourage ongoing referrals.



Track outreach, conversations, and opportunities in our CRM.



Collaborate with our experienced marketing and leadership teams to grow our partner network.



Why This Opportunity Is Different



1. Established Business, Not a Startup Experiment



Our law firm has an established presence, existing clients, and valuable business relationships. We're leveraging that foundation to accelerate the growth of our new DIY estate planning platform.



2. Warm Opportunities and Early Wins



You'll begin by working with existing relationships and promising opportunities before expanding into new business development.



3. An Experienced Team Behind You



You'll work alongside accomplished professionals in law, business, marketing, technology, and project management. You'll have the support and resources needed to succeed.



4. Long-Term Career Growth



We're building a business development department, not simply filling a temporary position. As the department grows, there will be opportunities for increased responsibility and leadership.



5. Performance Bonuses



We believe in rewarding results. In addition to your regular compensation, you'll have opportunities to earn bonuses for achieving business development milestones and measurable accomplishments.



Who We're Looking For



Experience in BDR, SDR, business development, B2B sales, appointment setting, or partnership outreach.



Excellent spoken and written English. (Please include a short video introducing yourself, sharing a little about your background, and explaining why you'd be a great fit for this position.)



Confident and professional communicating with U.S. business owners and executives.



Comfortable making outbound calls, sending
s, and conducting Zoom meetings.



Strong relationship-building and follow-up skills.



Organized, self-motivated, and comfortable working with CRM systems.



Able to understand a business opportunity and communicate its value.



Positive attitude, coachable, and motivated by measurable results.



Bonus qualifications:



Experience working with U.S. companies.



Background in financial services, insurance, legal services, or professional services.



Experience developing referral partnerships or affiliate relationships.



Familiarity with GoHighLevel or similar CRM platforms.



You do not need to be an estate planning expert. We'll teach you our services, systems, and partnership opportunities.



Schedule & Compensation



Schedule: Full-time, Monday–Friday



Hours: U.S. Eastern Time business hours



Compensation: Competitive base pay plus performance-based bonuses



Career: Long-term opportunity with advancement potential



What Success Looks Like



You'll help us activate existing relationships, establish new institutional partnerships, generate qualified referrals, and create recurring business opportunities for both our law firm and DIY estate planning platform.



We're looking for someone who enjoys connecting with people, recognizes business opportunities, and takes pride in building relationships that produce results.



Ready to Grow With Us?

title: Credit Repair Specialist
description:
This is a hands-on credit repair role. You will work client dispute files from start to finish, keep them documented, and keep clients informed on where they stand.

Pay and hours

- Part time, 20 hours/week, inside Central Time

- $3 to $4/hour based on experience shown

- Paid test file first, then a paid test run

- Raises tied to accuracy and results



This is not a training role. If you need someone to teach you how disputes work, this isn't it.



How to apply

Put the word DOCKET as the last word of your message, not the first. Then answer in your own words, in order:

1. Years working credit disputes, and what software you used day to day?

2. Walk me through the last file you carried, start to finish.

3. A dispute came back verified. What did you send next, and to whom?

4. How did you keep clients updated on where their file stood?

5. One mistake you made on a file and how you caught it.

Messages that skip the keyword or a question will not be read. Use AI if you want, but proofread it. Copied answers that don't match real experience get passed over.

title: Full-Time Junior Video Editor - Simple TikTok Shop Editing | Long-Term + Bonuses
description:
Looking for a long-term editing role with stable full-time hours and the opportunity to grow as the business expands?



We’re a fast-growing Germany-based TikTok Shop affiliate business looking for a reliable junior video editor we can grow with — not a one-off freelancer.



Strong performance can open the door to higher compensation and more responsibility over time.



You focus on editing. We provide the concepts, scripts/voiceovers, raw footage, reference videos, clear instructions and workflows.



WHAT YOU’LL DO



Turn raw footage into clean TikTok Shop videos by following our references and instructions.



Our recordings often include multiple takes and camera angles, so you need to identify the correct footage, remove mistakes and unnecessary parts, and turn it into a clean finished edit.



We care most about:



• Choosing the correct/best takes based on references

• Removing mistakes, pauses and dead time

• Clean cuts and good basic pacing

• Simple zoom-ins, zoom-outs and visual changes when needed

• Following references and instructions accurately

• Checking your own work before submitting



You do NOT need advanced motion graphics, creative strategy, professional sound design or advanced editing skills.



WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR



Someone with basic video editing experience who is reliable, detail-oriented and able to learn quickly.



You should already be comfortable with basic editing.



Previous editing experience is required, but you do not need to be an advanced editor. Around 1 year of experience is a plus, but strong junior editors with less experience are also welcome to apply.



More importantly, we want someone who can follow clear instructions, learn our workflow, notice mistakes and work independently without constant supervision.



Reliable communication, consistent work and willingness to learn are very important.



COMPENSATION & GROWTH



• 40 hours/week

• $475/month base salary

• Up to $50/month performance bonus ($525 total)

• Weekly payments during the first weeks

• 13th-month pay in accordance with applicable Philippine law

• Paid 2-month probationary period

• Stable long-term full-time position

• Potential for higher compensation and more responsibility as we grow



The performance bonus is based mainly on accuracy, work quality, reliability, meeting deadlines, organization and following instructions.



Higher compensation may be available for truly exceptional candidates.



PAID EDITING TEST



Shortlisted candidates will complete a short PAID editing test using real raw footage, clear instructions and a reference video.



HOW TO APPLY



IMPORTANT: Your APPLICATION TITLE must begin exactly with:



BLUE MANGO



For example:



BLUE MANGO – Video Editor Application



Applications that do not have BLUE MANGO at the beginning of the application title may not be reviewed.



Then send:



Links to your 2–3 BEST video edits. Short-form examples are preferred, but they do not need to be advanced.



Briefly tell us about your video editing experience, previous relevant work and which editing software you use.



Imagine you receive raw footage with multiple takes, mistakes and pauses, plus a reference video. Briefly explain how you would approach turning it into the finished video.



Confirm that you can reliably commit to 40 hours/week.



Are you currently working for another employer or client? If yes, approximately how many hours per week?



Briefly describe your internet/power reliability and backup setup.



Confirm that $475/month base + up to $50/month performance bonus works for you. If your expected compensation is higher, you may state it.



Our goal is to find a reliable editor who wants to become very good at our workflow and work with us long-term.



We look forward to reviewing your application and hopefully getting to know you better.

title: # Cold Calling & Sales Role-Play Coach — 1-on-1 Training
description:
I am looking for an experienced **Sales Coach / Sales Trainer / Cold Calling Trainer** to work with me one-on-one.



I am **not looking for someone to make cold calls for me**. I am looking for someone who will **personally train and coach me so I become much better at cold calling and selling.**



The right person should be comfortable actively coaching me, challenging me, correcting me, and doing realistic role-plays with me.



## What I Want to Learn



I want to become confident and effective on the phone, including:



* How to start a cold call confidently

* How to create and deliver a strong pitch

* What exactly to say and how to say it

* How to sound confident, natural, and conversational

* How to avoid sounding nervous, robotic, or overly scripted

* How to ask good questions

* How to keep the prospect engaged

* How to identify the prospect's needs

* How to transition naturally into the offer

* How to ask for the appointment or sale

* How to handle rejection

* How to handle difficult prospects

* How to overcome common objections

* How to think on my feet when the prospect says something unexpected

* How to become more comfortable and confident through repeated practice



## I Want REAL Role-Playing



This is extremely important.



I want you to actually **play the role of the prospect** while I practice calling you.



For example, you might act like a prospect who says:



> "I'm not interested."



Then I respond.



You challenge me again.



You might say:



> "Just send me an
."



Or:



> "We already have someone."



Or:



> "How much does it cost?"



Or:



> "Where did you get my number?"



Or give me another realistic objection.



I want you to **challenge me instead of making the role-play easy.**



After the role-play, I want you to explain:



* What I did well

* What I did poorly

* Where I sounded uncertain

* What I should have said instead

* How I could improve my wording

* How I could sound more confident

* Where I talked too much

* Where I should have asked a question

* Where I should have pushed back

* How I could have moved the conversation toward an appointment or sale



Then I want to **do the role-play again** and apply your corrections.



## I Want a Coach Who Will Push Me



Please don't simply tell me that everything sounds good.



I want someone who will respectfully **challenge me and point out my weaknesses**.



If my pitch is weak, tell me.



If I sound nervous, tell me.



If I'm talking too much, stop me.



If I'm asking the wrong question, explain what I should ask.



If I'm avoiding asking for the sale, challenge me to actually ask.



The goal is for me to improve through **repetition, feedback, and realistic practice.**



## Help Me Build My Pitch



I would also like help developing and improving my actual sales pitch.



You should be able to help me:



1. Understand the product/service I'm selling

2. Create a strong opening

3. Develop the pitch

4. Create good discovery questions

5. Prepare responses to common objections

6. Practice the entire conversation

7. Adjust the script so it sounds natural rather than memorized

8. Practice until I can deliver it confidently



## Experience I'm Looking For



You should have significant experience in one or more of the following:



* Cold calling

* B2B sales

* B2C sales

* Sales training

* Sales coaching

* Sales management

* SDR/BDR training

* Business development

* Appointment setting

* Closing

* Objection handling

* Phone sales

* Sales role-playing

* Sales performance coaching



**Teaching/coaching ability is very important.**



Being a good salesperson alone is not enough. You need to be able to **teach another person how to sell.**



## Sample Video — VERY IMPORTANT



If you have a video showing yourself doing any of the following, please send it with your application:



* Sales coaching

* Cold-call training

* Role-playing a sales call

* Teaching someone how to sell

* Demonstrating a cold call

* Handling objections

* Training salespeople



It does **not** have to be a professionally produced video.



I mainly want to see **how you actually teach and coach.**



If you don't have an existing video, you may record a short sample explaining how you would coach someone through a cold call.



## Please Include Your Desired Rate



Please tell me **how much you are asking per hour** for this type of one-on-one coaching.



Do not simply write "negotiable."



Please provide your actual requested hourly rate.



## Please Answer These Questions



1. How many years of sales experience do you have?

2. How many years of sales training/coaching experience do you have?

3. Have you personally trained people to cold call?

4. Have you done live sales role-play with students or salespeople?

5. What types of products/services have you sold?

6. What type of sales were you involved in — B2B, B2C, high-ticket, appointment setting, closing, etc.?

7. How do you normally structure a one-on-one sales coaching session?

8. How do you teach someone to sound more confident on the phone?

9. How do you teach objection handling?

10. Are you comfortable challenging the student rather than simply giving encouragement?

11. Do you have a sample video? **Please provide the link.**

12. What is your desired hourly rate?



## Top 3 Skills



Please make sure your profile/application highlights these three skills:



**1. Cold Calling & Sales Training**



**2. Sales Role-Play & Objection Handling**



**3. Sales Pitch, Confidence & Communication Coaching**



I am looking for someone interested in **ongoing one-on-one coaching**, not just a one-time session.



Please apply with your experience, sample video if available, and desired hourly rate.

Student Experience Support & Executive Assistant

Working Hours: Approximately 3–4 hours per working day to start, Monday–Friday

READ BEFORE APPLYING: APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS ARE STRICTLY ENFORCED



We are looking for someone who pays attention to detail, follows instructions carefully, communicates clearly, and takes ownership of their work.



To be considered, you MUST complete all three application steps listed at the bottom of this posting.



We will NOT accept applications that:

-Do not follow the application instructions.

-Include generic introduction videos or videos reused from other job applications.

-Contain AI-generated introductions, application responses, or other submissions presented as the applicant's own original work.

-Fail to include the required resume, references, or personalized introduction video.



Please read the entire job posting carefully before applying.



ABOUT IWACU FLAVORS



Iwacu Flavors is a plant-based culinary education business founded by Chef Vasta, a Rwandan chef and educator.

Through Iwacu Plant-Based Academy, we help students build confidence in the kitchen, explore new ingredients, and develop practical cooking skills through interactive virtual cooking classes.



As we prepare to expand our virtual education programs in 2027, we are looking for a proactive, organized, and dependable assistant who can help us deliver an excellent student experience while supporting the founder with essential administrative responsibilities.



ABOUT THE ROLE



The primary responsibility of this position is student experience, communication, and retention, with executive and administrative support as a secondary responsibility.



You will help ensure that every student feels supported, receives timely communication, and has a positive learning experience. You will maintain accurate student records, manage follow-ups, coordinate class logistics, and keep essential administrative systems organized.



We need someone who takes initiative rather than waiting for instructions. You should be comfortable managing multiple conversations, tracking outstanding tasks, anticipating student needs, and working independently in a remote environment.



This is NOT a marketing, lead generation, or sales position. Our marketing and video production team members handle those responsibilities independently.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Student Experience, Communication & Retention

- This is the highest priority of the role.

- Maintain accurate student records, including learning goals, class history, attendance, remaining sessions, and communication history.

- Track when students were last contacted and identify when follow-ups are needed.

- Proactively follow up with students who miss classes, become less engaged, have outstanding questions, or are approaching the end of their learning packages.

- Monitor student
s and messages to ensure important inquiries receive timely attention.

- Build positive relationships with students through thoughtful, personalized communication.

- Track student feedback, progress, engagement, and renewal opportunities.

- Keep student information updated in GoHighLevel (GHL) and other designated systems.

- Provide regular updates on student relationships, pending follow-ups, and potential concerns.



2. Live Virtual Cooking Class Support

- Attendance at assigned live group cooking classes is MANDATORY.



Before class:

- Confirm that students receive class instructions, ingredient lists, and Zoom links.

- Respond to logistical questions and coordinate with Chef Vasta when necessary.



During class:

- Attend and assist with Zoom operations.

- Monitor the chat and answer logistical questions.

- Bring culinary questions to Chef Vasta's attention.

- Track attendance and take organized class notes.

- Identify students who may need follow-up support.



After class:

- Organize class notes and coordinate the distribution of approved recipes, recordings, and learning materials.

- Update student records.

- Follow up on outstanding student questions or concerns.

- Group classes are generally expected Monday through Thursday, with the possibility of expanding to Friday. Classes typically begin around 6:00 PM Denver Mountain Time, although schedules may vary.



You must be willing and able to adjust your working hours to attend assigned classes. Private or individual class attendance is generally not required, but you will coordinate student communication and follow-ups for those sessions.



3. Executive & Administrative Support

- Monitor and organize the founder's business inbox.

- Respond to routine business
s and flag matters requiring the founder's attention.

- Manage scheduling, calendar coordination, and administrative follow-ups.

- Track important commitments, outstanding requests, and next steps.

- Coordinate communication between the founder and team members when necessary.

title: Short-Form Video Editor – TikTok, Reels & YouTube Shorts
description:
# Short-Form Video Editor for Locksmith Business (Part-Time, Remote)



**Employment Type:** Part-Time  

**Monthly Budget:** $250–$300 USD, depending on experience  

**Hours per Week:** Approximately 8–12 hours  

**Location:** Remote — Philippines preferred



## About the Role



I'm the owner of On Key Locksmith, a locksmith business based in South Florida, USA. I'm looking for a creative, reliable video editor to help grow our social media presence through engaging short-form video content.



I will record the videos myself and provide the raw footage. Your job is to transform that footage into polished, engaging videos ready to publish on TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.



Our content will feature real locksmith work, car lockouts, lock replacements, interesting jobs, behind-the-scenes footage, and educational or entertaining locksmith-related content.



My goal is to build a strong social media presence, grow our audience, and eventually reach a large following on TikTok. I'm looking for someone who understands short-form content and knows how to capture attention, maintain viewer interest, and make videos enjoyable to watch.



This is a part-time position with the potential for more work as the business and our social media accounts grow.



## Responsibilities



- Edit approximately 5 short-form videos per week using raw footage I provide.

- Create engaging videos, typically 30–90 seconds long, depending on the content.

- Add attention-grabbing hooks, clean subtitles, text overlays, appropriate music, sound effects, and smooth transitions when needed.

- Improve pacing and remove unnecessary pauses or footage to keep viewers engaged.

- Suggest creative editing ideas that could make the content more entertaining, educational, or shareable.

- Format and export videos in vertical 9:16 format for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.

- Provide clean, high-quality exports without platform watermarks.

- Follow brand guidelines and maintain a consistent style.

- Deliver finished videos on time and make reasonable revisions when needed.

- Stay aware of short-form content trends and suggest ideas that fit our locksmith niche.



## What I'm Looking For



- Experience editing TikToks, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.

- A portfolio demonstrating engaging short-form videos.

- Good understanding of hooks, storytelling, pacing, and audience retention.

- Ability to create clean, readable subtitles and professional-looking text overlays.

- Familiarity with CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or similar editing software.

- Good written English and attention to detail.

- Reliable communication and ability to meet deadlines.

- Creativity and willingness to suggest improvements instead of simply following instructions.



Experience editing content for creators, tradespeople, automotive businesses, or home-service businesses is a plus, but not required.



## Workload and Compensation



The initial workload will be approximately 5-8 videos per week, or around 20–26 videos per month.



The starting budget is $250–$300 USD per month, depending on your experience, editing quality, and agreed workload.



We will begin with a paid test video to evaluate editing quality, creativity, communication, and turnaround time. If we are a good fit, I am looking for a long-term working relationship.



There is room to increase the workload and compensation as the business grows and the quality of work proves consistent.



## How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. A link to 3–5 short-form videos you have personally edited.

2. Which video editing software you use.

3. Your expected monthly compensation for editing approximately 5 videos per week.

4. Approximately how long it takes you to edit a typical 60-second video.

5. Your current availability and how many hours per week you can commit.

6. One example of how you would make an ordinary video more engaging in the first 3 seconds.



**Important:** Please include the word **LOCKSMITH** at the beginning of your application so I know you have read the full job post.



I'm looking for someone creative, dependable, and interested in helping grow a brand over the long term.

title: Internal Payroll Coordinator (Remote)
description:

Maintain and coordinate payroll-related employee and worker information.

Maintain payroll reports, approvals, reconciliation records, and supporting documentation.

Assist with payroll accounting, reporting, periodic documentation, and process improvements.

Requirements

Hands-on experience processing or coordinating U.S. payroll is required.

Working knowledge of U.S. federal, state, and local payroll tax withholding requirements.

Practical experience reviewing payroll information, deductions, adjustments, tax withholdings, payroll reports, and payment results.

Experience identifying and resolving payroll discrepancies or coordinating corrections with a payroll provider.

Experience working with a third-party payroll provider or payroll processing system.

Strong numerical accuracy and attention to detail.

Ability to review payroll data and identify missing, inconsistent, or unusual information.

Good organizational, reconciliation, and problem-solving skills.

Ability to manage recurring payroll deadlines and follow up on outstanding requirements.

Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

Ability to coordinate professionally with employees, managers, internal departments, and external service providers.

Ability to handle confidential payroll, compensation, banking, tax, and employee information responsibly.

Ability to work independently in a structured remote environment.

Educational background in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.
