title: Dropship Supply Chain Manager
description:
ABOUT US



We are a Global e-commerce company running a growing portfolio of 30+ Shopify stores, mainly in fashion, jewellery and homeware. We work with China-based suppliers and fulfilment agents and ship to customers across Europe and other international markets.



We are looking for an experienced Supply Chain Manager to lead our supply chain team, stay hands-on with daily operations and drive measurable improvements in our fulfilment performance.





ABOUT THE ROLE



- Remote, full-time, long-term position

- You will manage 2 direct reports

- Roughly 50% hands-on operational work and 50% team management and improvement

- You will report directly to the Operations Manager and work closely with the Customer Service Manager





KPIs YOU WILL OWN



- Order processing time: under 3 days

- Delivery time: under 10 days

- OOS save rate: above 80%

- Fulfilment rate: above 98%

- Product and inventory health: no more than 3% of inventory requiring follow-up





RESPONSIBILITIES



Hands-on operations:

- Handle a share of daily order processing, fulfilment exceptions, supplier follow-up and OOS cases across all stores

- Investigate and resolve processing delays, stalled shipments, address issues, returns to sender, lost parcels and product quality concerns

- Work with suppliers and agents to resolve sourcing and dispatch issues and agree corrective actions

- Monitor product availability and make sure every item needing follow-up has an owner and gets resolved

- Coordinate with customer service so order issues and OOS recovery are followed through to resolution



Team management:

- Build strong working relationships with your 2 team members and understand their strengths and support needs

- Allocate work, set clear priorities, deadlines and ownership

- Review progress and work quality, coach your team and address missed commitments constructively

- Make sure the team understands the KPIs and how their daily work affects them

- Escalate risks and capacity issues early, with clear options and recommendations



KPI ownership, improvement and reporting:

- Run root cause analysis on recurring issues (process, supplier, system or workload) and implement fixes that prevent them from happening again

- Identify and propose practical automations for monitoring, alerts, follow-up and reporting, then help test and measure them

- Build a prioritised improvement plan and agree actions, owners and timelines with the Operations Manager

- Send daily reports on KPI performance, open exceptions, urgent risks and action progress

- Hold weekly reviews on KPI trends, root causes, corrective actions and automation results





YOUR FIRST MONTH



- Work alongside both team members to learn the processes, suppliers, systems and handovers

- Review live cases and current KPI results to understand the starting point

- Take on an operational workload from the start and help resolve live issues

- Deliver a practical, evidence-based plan to reach all five KPI targets, reviewed with the Operations Manager within your first month





REQUIREMENTS



- Direct, hands-on (high sku) dropshipping experience in high volume operations (required)

- Direct experience with managing and improving supply chain operations for dropshipping company

- Solid understanding of supplier and fulfilment agent workflows, OOS issues and order exceptions

- Practical knowledge of supplier sourcing, China-based fulfilment and international shipping

- Proven direct line management experience: assigning work, setting expectations, coaching and holding people accountable (required)

- A track record of improving operational KPIs, with clear before and after results

- Strong Google Sheets or Excel skills

- Experience with root cause analysis and daily and weekly operational reporting

- Excellent written and spoken English





STRONG ADVANTAGES



- High-volume, multi-store Shopify experience

- Fashion or apparel dropshipping experience

- Experience with CJdropshipping or a similar agent

- Experience with ParcelPanel or 17TRACK

- Experience building operational dashboards and automations

- Experience serving customers in Europe, the UK, US, Canada or Australia





HOW TO APPLY



Send your application with:

1. Your CV

2. A short summary of your dropshipping and fulfilment experience, including the suppliers or agents you have worked with

3. One example of a KPI you improved: the starting point, what you did and the result

4. The number of people you have directly managed and for how long

5. Your expected monthly salary



Start your application with the words "Supply Chain Lead" so we know you read the full post. Applications without this will not be considered.

title: Real Estate Operations Manager
description:
# Real Estate Operations Manager | $7–$10/hr + Performance Incentives



We are a growing U.S. real estate company looking for a highly organized, experienced **Real Estate Operations Manager** to help oversee the day-to-day operations of our sales, lead generation, transaction, and administrative systems.



This is **not a basic administrative or virtual assistant position.**



We are looking for someone who understands how a real estate operation works, is comfortable managing people, numbers, systems, and processes, and can become the person management relies on to know **what is happening, what needs attention, and what needs to happen next.**



You will work across multiple parts of the business, including:



* Seller lead management

* ISA operations

* CRM organization

* Dialer campaigns

* SMS marketing

* Property underwriting

* MLS research

* Payroll tracking

* Transaction coordination

* Team accountability

* Reporting

* Process improvement



The ideal candidate is someone who takes ownership, solves problems proactively, and does not need to be reminded about every task.



## Compensation



**$7.00–$10.00/hour**, depending on experience, skill level, real estate knowledge, and familiarity with our systems.



There may also be opportunities for:



* Performance bonuses

* Commissions

* Increased compensation based on results

* Expanded responsibilities as the company grows



Candidates with strong experience in several of the following may qualify toward the higher end of the range:



* ReadyMode

* Smarter Contact

* Follow Up Boss

* Dotloop

* MLS

* Real estate underwriting

* Comparable sales analysis

* ISA management

* Real estate operations

* Wholesaling or investment real estate



Compensation and responsibilities may grow based on demonstrated performance and ownership of the role.



# Core Responsibilities



## Property Underwriting & Deal Review



You will help management and acquisitions quickly understand whether seller opportunities are worth pursuing.



Responsibilities may include:



* Reviewing incoming seller leads and property opportunities

* Researching property values and comparable sales

* Pulling and analyzing MLS comps

* Reviewing property history and prior sales

* Evaluating active, pending, and sold listings

* Assisting with ARV calculations

* Reviewing estimated repair information

* Helping determine potential offer ranges

* Reviewing equity and deal viability

* Organizing seller and property information for acquisitions

* Prioritizing opportunities based on motivation, equity, property condition, timeline, and potential value



You should be comfortable looking at property data and turning it into useful information for a sales or acquisitions team.



## Lead Management & CRM Operations



You will help ensure our seller leads are properly organized, assigned, worked, and followed up with.



Responsibilities include:



* Managing and organizing leads inside our CRM

* Monitoring lead stages and dispositions

* Ensuring follow-up tasks are being completed

* Identifying neglected or improperly managed leads

* Maintaining organized lead lists

* Creating follow-up categories

* Helping maintain nurture campaigns

* Monitoring lead flow through the sales pipeline

* Ensuring qualified opportunities reach the appropriate team member

* Identifying leads that need additional attention

* Improving lead organization and follow-up processes



A major part of this role is making sure **good opportunities do not fall through the cracks.**



## ReadyMode Management



Experience with **ReadyMode** is strongly preferred.



You may be responsible for:



* Uploading lead lists

* Organizing campaigns

* Creating dialing campaigns

* Managing campaign settings

* Managing lead distribution

* Maintaining dispositions

* Maintaining follow-up lists

* Monitoring ISA activity

* Reviewing campaign performance

* Helping troubleshoot basic dialer or campaign issues

* Ensuring leads are being distributed and worked correctly

* Helping management identify productivity or performance issues



Candidates with experience managing another high-volume outbound dialer may also be considered.



## SMS Marketing & Smarter Contact



You will also help manage our outbound SMS lead generation.



Responsibilities may include:



* Creating SMS campaigns in Smarter Contact

* Uploading and organizing prospect lists

* Segmenting leads correctly

* Writing and scheduling campaigns

* Monitoring replies

* Routing opportunities to the appropriate team member

* Tracking campaign results

* Maintaining clean contact databases

* Creating nurture and follow-up campaigns

* Helping test messaging and campaign strategies

* Preventing duplicate or improperly segmented contacts



Experience with **Smarter Contact** is a major advantage.



## ISA Team Operations



You will help support the day-to-day management of our Inside Sales Agent team.



Responsibilities may include:



* Monitoring attendance

* Monitoring schedules and hours

* Reviewing productivity

* Reviewing call activity

* Tracking KPIs

* Helping coordinate training

* Assisting with onboarding and offboarding

* Maintaining employee and contractor records

* Communicating procedures and expectations

* Helping identify performance issues

* Following up on accountability items

* Assisting management with performance reporting



You should be comfortable holding team members accountable in a professional and respectful way.



This does not mean micromanaging the team.



It means ensuring expectations are clear, numbers are visible, problems are identified early, and commitments are followed through.



## Payroll & Administrative Operations



You may also assist with operational payroll preparation.



Responsibilities may include:



* Tracking employee and contractor hours

* Reviewing time records

* Preparing payroll information

* Maintaining payroll records

* Tracking commissions

* Tracking bonuses

* Identifying inconsistencies before payroll is submitted

* Maintaining accurate internal compensation records



Accuracy and attention to detail are extremely important.



## Dotloop & Transaction Support



You will help ensure our real estate transaction files stay organized from contract through closing.



Responsibilities may include:



* Creating transaction files in Dotloop

* Uploading contracts

* Uploading disclosures

* Organizing amendments and addenda

* Monitoring documents for missing information

* Checking signature completion

* Helping maintain accurate transaction records

* Assisting agents and management with transaction organization

* Tracking important documents and deadlines

* Helping keep files complete and audit-ready



Direct transaction coordination experience is a strong advantage.



## MLS & Property Research



You should be comfortable working with MLS data or be experienced enough in real estate research to learn our process quickly.



Responsibilities may include:



* Pulling comparable properties

* Reviewing sold properties

* Reviewing active and pending listings

* Researching property history

* Reviewing prior listing activity

* Analyzing market activity

* Helping determine pricing ranges

* Assisting with underwriting

* Preparing property information for management, agents, and acquisitions staff



Strong attention to detail is essential when reviewing comparable properties.



## Seller Lead Nurturing



Some seller opportunities require weeks or months of follow-up before they are ready to move forward.



You may help ensure those opportunities stay active.



Responsibilities may include:



* Following up with seller leads

* Checking for changes in motivation

* Checking timeline changes

* Discussing updated pricing expectations

* Maintaining long-term relationships

* Documenting conversations

* Updating CRM information

* Identifying newly motivated sellers

* Returning qualified opportunities to acquisitions or sales



You should be persistent and organized without being unnecessarily aggressive.



# Systems Experience



Experience with several of the following is strongly preferred:



* **ReadyMode**

* **Smarter Contact**

* **Follow Up Boss**

* **Dotloop**

* **MLS**

* Google Workspace

* Google Sheets

* Real estate CRM systems

* SMS marketing platforms

* Lead databases

* Outbound dialers

* Property research tools

* Comparable sales analysis

* Real estate investor systems

* Wholesaling systems

* Transaction management platforms



You do not need experience with every system listed.



However, candidates with direct experience using multiple systems in an actual real estate operation will receive stronger consideration.



# Who We Are Looking For



The ideal candidate is:



* Extremely organized

* Detail-oriented

* Reliable

* Comfortable managing several moving pieces at once

* Able to prioritize effectively

* Comfortable with numbers and spreadsheets

* Strong with technology

* Fast at learning new software

* Experienced with real estate terminology

* Comfortable researching properties

* Comfortable reviewing comparable sales

* Comfortable communicating with team members

* Comfortable holding people accountable

* Able to work independently

* Proactive about identifying problems

* Strong at documenting processes

* Comfortable improving existing systems

* Able to recognize inefficiencies

* Calm when multiple priorities compete for attention

* Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment

* Someone who takes ownership instead of waiting for instructions



We especially value someone who thinks:



**“I saw the problem, figured out what caused it, fixed it, documented it, and made sure it does not keep happening.”**



# Preferred Background



We would especially like to hear from candidates who have previously worked as a:



* Real Estate Operations Manager

* Real Estate Office Manager

* Real Estate Operations Coordinator

* Real Estate Virtual Assistant Manager

* Transaction Coordinator

* Lead Manager

* ISA Manager

* Acquisitions Assistant

* Acquisitions Coordinator

* Real Estate Executive Assistant

* Real Estate Investor Operations Manager

* Wholesaling Operations Manager



Experience working with a:



* Real estate brokerage

* Real estate investment company

* Wholesaling company

* Acquisition team

* High-volume ISA organization

* Seller lead generation company



is highly preferred.



# What Success Looks Like



The successful person in this role becomes the person who can answer:



**Where do our leads stand?**



**Are our campaigns running correctly?**



**Are the ISAs working the right opportunities?**



**Which sellers need immediate attention?**



**What leads are falling behind?**



**What deals need underwriting?**



**Are our payroll numbers correct?**



**Are transaction files complete?**



**Are follow-ups happening?**



**What operational problems need management's attention?**



When this role is working well:



* Leads are organized.

* Campaigns are active.

* ISAs know what they should be doing.

* Follow-up is consistent.

* Seller opportunities are properly nurtured.

* Payroll information is accurate.

* Property numbers are reviewed.

* MLS research is completed correctly.

* Transactions are organized.

* CRM information is current.

* Management has visibility into performance.

* Problems are identified before they become emergencies.



Our goal is for management to be able to focus on higher-level decisions instead of personally chasing every operational detail.



# This Role Is NOT For You If



Please do not apply if:



* You need constant supervision

* You wait to be told about obvious problems

* You regularly forget follow-ups

* You struggle managing multiple systems

* You dislike working with spreadsheets or numbers

* You are uncomfortable learning new technology

* You have no interest in understanding real estate

* You avoid holding team members accountable

* You struggle with detailed administrative work

* You are looking for a simple task-based VA role

* You are uncomfortable taking ownership of results



This position requires someone who can manage both **details and the bigger operational picture.**



# How to Apply



Send your application to:







Use the subject line:



**Application – Real Estate Operations Manager**



Please answer the following questions:



1. Describe your previous real estate experience.



2. Have you previously managed operations for a real estate team, brokerage, investor, or wholesaling company? Please explain.



3. Which of the following systems have you personally used?



 * ReadyMode

 * Smarter Contact

 * Follow Up Boss

 * Dotloop

 * MLS

 * Other real estate CRMs or dialers



4. Describe your experience managing leads and CRM pipelines.



5. Have you managed an ISA or sales team? If yes, how many people and what KPIs did you track?



6. Describe your experience with MLS research and comparable sales.



7. Are you comfortable calculating or reviewing ARV and evaluating investment opportunities?



8. Describe your experience with transaction coordination or Dotloop.



9. Have you handled payroll, time tracking, commissions, or contractor payments?



10. Describe one operational problem you identified and solved without being specifically instructed to fix it.



11. What reports or KPIs have you been responsible for maintaining?



12. How do you make sure important tasks and leads do not fall through the cracks?



13. What is your current availability and preferred working schedule?



Please also include a **short voice or video introduction**.



Tell us briefly:



* Who you are

* Your real estate background

* Your strongest operations skill

* The systems you know best

* Why you believe you would succeed in this role



Applications with **specific examples, measurable results, screenshots, reports, process improvements, or descriptions of systems you personally managed** will receive stronger consideration.



We are looking for someone who wants to **take ownership of the position, become an important part of the team, and grow with the company.**



**Compensation: $4–$7/hour + potential commissions/performance incentives**

title: Photo Editor & Graphic Designer
description:

We work with large programs, photographing anywhere from 15 to 1500 subjects in a short amount of time. Some days we run multiple shoots. Our goal is to deliver photos within 48 hours and banners and composites within a 72-hour turnaround. As we continue to grow, we are looking for a skilled Photo Editor & Designer to join our creative team.



ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking a detail-oriented Photo Editor & Designer who excels in high-volume photo editing, color correction, and creative design. You will work closely with Me, the owner and main photographer, to ensure every image and graphic meets our brand's visual standards and supports our clients' needs.



• Your top priority is fast, high-volume editing and retouching.

• Communication is very important because we move fast.

• Every subject gets a private gallery link. File naming, sorting, and accuracy d
 whether the right photo reaches the right family. Attention to detail is required.

• This role is ideal for an editor who responds promptly, welcomes direction, and raises concerns early. It is not a fit for candidates who need a fixed schedule or who cannot commit to timely communication.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

• You reply within 4 hours on any day we are actively working on photoshoots. You reply the same day on all other days.

• You deliver basic edits within 24 hours for my review. Photos are final within 48 hours. Your edits are ready for my review when I start my day.

• You deliver banner and composite designs within 72 hours.

• You share status updates with management right away at every milestone and when a problem comes up.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Edit and retouch photos for color, exposure, and dynamic impact

• Deliver basic edits within 24 hours for my review before anything is uploaded to our delivery platform

• Perform advanced extractions (cut-outs, background removal, compositing)

• Design banners, composites, posters, and custom graphics for print and digital use

• Collaborate with the team to maintain consistent style and quality

• Take direction, flag problems early, and share status updates immediately

• Check every name against the roster and match it to the right photo

• Keep backdrops and crops consistent across every subject

• Prepare files for print and digital delivery (correct sizing, resolution, and format)

• Meet deadlines and manage multiple projects simultaneously (48-hour photo delivery, 72-hour banner and composite turnaround)

• Organize programs and project details using Excel or Google Sheets



REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

• Willingness to learn our editing programs and workflows quickly: Evoto, Imagen, Photo Mechanic, Pixnub, and PhotoDay tools

• Strong portfolio of edited images and design projects

• Skilled in color correction, retouching, and dynamic photo enhancement

• Fast, high-volume editing

• Experience with extractions and compositing

• Ability to design banners, composites, posters, and marketing graphics

• Detail-oriented, organized, and able to follow creative direction

• Experience in sports, school, or team photography editing is a plus

• Comfortable with high-volume, fast-paced workflows

• Proficient in Excel or Google Sheets for organizing programs

• Willingness to learn new programs and tools as needed

• Clear written and spoken English

WORKING HOURS & COMPENSATION

• Remote work

• Preferred: Editing to be completed overnight Pacific time to allow us to review your work first thing in the morning and collaborate with you that same day.

• Pay starts at $4.50 per hour. We review your rate after 6 months.



HOW TO APPLY

Send your resume and a brief cover letter. Please include:

• Examples of photos you have personally photographed (if applicable)

• A list of editing/design programs you have used

• Your experience with Excel or Google Sheets

• A statement about your willingness to learn new programs

• Any experience with sports, school, or team photography, banner and composite design, or advanced retouching

• Your availability to edit overnight Pacific time (afternoon and evening in the Philippines) and the hours you can reply

• A yes or no: can you reply within 4 hours and deliver a basic edit within 24 hours?

Then complete a skills assessment. It includes a photo editing task, a banner design task, a quality control scenario, and a communication task. You will have 48 hours to finish. We score speed, accuracy, attention to detail, and how fast you reply.



You will work closely with the owner and studio manager. We look forward to seeing how your creative skills can help KG Studios deliver outstanding images and products to our clients!

title: Admin & Marketing Virtual Assistant for Business Coach
description:
Virtual Assistant for Business Coach



Part-Time Contractor | Remote | Long-Term Opportunity



ABOUT THE ROLE



Hi! I’m Christina, founder of Kroder Creative, a coaching and marketing company that helps female holistic health practitioners and coaches build profitable businesses, consistently sign clients, and simplify their marketing — while becoming the best versions of themselves!



My business is growing, and I’m looking for a part-time Admin & Marketing Virtual Assistant who is excited to grow with me and become an important part of the behind-the-scenes execution of my business and marketing.



This is not just an administrative role.



I’m looking for someone who is  a “do”er, organized, proactive, creative, tech-savvy, and excited about supporting a female coach on the back end and in digital marketing. 



I am the strategist and primary content creator. Your job is to help me bring those ideas to life, distribute them, organize them, and keep the machine moving.



Role and Responsibilities 



-Upload Weekly Coaching Calls — Download calls from Zoom, upload to Loom, and add them to MemberVault with Fathom notes.

-Community + Client Support — Schedule recurring
 Group posts,
s, reminders, and other client communications.

-Content Creation + Repurposing — Turn ideas and content I provide into social posts, Reels, Stories, carousels, captions, and graphics.

-Website + Webinar Support — Make simple updates to existing WordPress/Beaver Builder and MailerLite pages and update recurring webinar dates,
s, links, and graphics.

-Lead Generation Support — Research potential leads, help follow up with people engaging with my
 content, find places for me to be more visible where my ideal clients are, create leads lists, add qualified leads to our tracker, and research local and virtual holistic health practitioners I can connect with.

-Weekly Team Meeting — Attend a weekly check-in with me to review priorities, questions, and upcoming projects.

-Other Projects — Help with additional behind-the-scenes and marketing projects as the role and business grow.



THE PERSON I'M LOOKING FOR

Skills matter, but how you work matters even more to me.



You are someone who:

Is extremely organized and pays attention to the little details

Is a “do”er who is motivated to get things done

Is a systems oriented person

Loves following a process repeatably

Loves creating a checklist and getting things checked off the list

Takes ownership and follows tasks through to completion

Works independently without needing constant reminders

Communicates clearly and knows when to ask questions

Looks for solutions instead of waiting to be told what to do

Enjoys learning new software, tools, and systems

Has an eye for clean, polished design

Enjoys content, marketing, and social media

Can creatively repurpose an existing idea

Can do research and build lists of ideas, leads, etc

Is comfortable receiving feedback and making adjustments

Notices opportunities for improvement and speaks up

Is reliable and wants a long-term role that can grow over time



I don’t expect you to know everything on Day 1.



I’d much rather hire someone who is resourceful curious,, dependable, and excited to learn than someone who knows every platform but needs constant direction.



Experience with Zoom, Loom, MemberVault, Fathom, Canva, MailerLite, WordPress/Beaver Builder, Instagram, Google Drive, and simple video editing is a plus, but not required. Willingness to learn is a must.



THIS POSITION PROBABLY ISN'T RIGHT FOR YOU IF...

You need every individual step assigned before taking action

You frequently miss small details or deadlines

You prefer doing only one narrow type of task

You don’t enjoy marketing, content, or social media

You aren’t comfortable receiving feedback

You wait for problems to be solved instead of looking for solutions

You’re looking for a short-term gig



YOU'LL LOVE THIS ROLE IF...

You get weirdly excited about organizing things 😂

You love creating and following simple processes

You love turning one idea into multiple pieces of marketing

You’re the person who catches the typo or broken link everyone else missed

You enjoy learning new tools and figuring things out

You’re comfortable saying, “Hey Christina, I noticed this. What if we tried ___?”

You want to understand the bigger picture behind your tasks — not just check boxes

You enjoy working independently while still collaborating and communicating

You’d love to grow into a larger role as the company grows

You care about helping make the world a better place through natural healthcare



Role Details:

Location: Remote

Start Date: Target Mid November 2026

Hours: 5 hours per week with room to grow

Type: Independent Contractor



WHAT IT'S LIKE TO WORK WITH ME

I care about creating a business that is both successful and enjoyable to run.

I care deeply about my clients, have lots of ideas (this is why I need your help bringing more of them to life!), and love experimenting with ways to make our marketing and systems simpler and better.



I don't want to micromanage you.



I'll give you clear expectations, examples, feedback and the tools you need to succeed—and then I want to trust you to take ownership of your responsibilities.



I also don't expect perfection. If you don't know something, ask. If you make a mistake, tell me. If you see a better way to do something, bring it to me.



Open, honest communication is incredibly important to me.



You'll have opportunities to learn how an online coaching business operates from the inside, develop new skills, take on more responsibility and grow your hours and compensation as the role and company grow.



I take my work seriously, but I also like to have FUN. ✨



HOW TO APPLY



Please reply with:

1. Your resume

2. A 30-second video sharing why you think you’d be a great fit for this role



If you meet our criteria, we’ll contact you directly to set up an interview.

title: Assistant Property Manager
description:
*KINDLY READ THE JOB DESCRIPTION & THE APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS CAREFULLY.*



EJF is a property management company headquartered in Washington, DC. We are looking for Assistant Property Managers for our growing team. A successful candidate will enjoy solving problems, is responsible, organized, detail oriented, and reliable.



Role Purpose:



The Associate Community Manager (ACM) is responsible for supporting the Community Association Manager (CAM) in the daily operations, financial oversight, administrative functions, and resident/board communications of assigned associations. The ACM ensures timely execution of operational tasks, accurate financial processing, regulatory compliance, and consistent communication, allowing the CAM to focus on strategic management and board leadership.



Core Responsibilities:



1. Communication & Responsiveness:



Respond to resident, vendor, and internal inquiries within 2 business hours.

Respond to board member requests, concerns, and follow-ups in a timely and professional manner.

Prepare and distribute broadcast
s, notices, and announcements to residents.

Address and escalate property-related issues as appropriate.

Participate in and contribute to daily huddles.

Prepare and send weekly updates.



2. Financial & Accounting Support:



Review and approve invoices.

Ensure monthly utility bills are processed and paid on time.

Review invoice GL coding, descriptions, and amounts for accuracy.

Run General Ledger (GL) reports.

Review monthly financial statements and reclassify mis-coded transactions.

Bill back homeowners for chargeable items.

Submit add-charge requests as required.

Assist the CAM with preparation of annual association budgets.



3. Vendor, Contract & Procurement Support:



Gather and organize existing contracts.

Request bids and proposals from vendors in coordination with the CAM.

Schedule and track annual preventive maintenance.

Assist CAM with Capital Expenditure (CapEx) projects and insurance claim administration.



4. Operations & Work Order Management:



Create and manage work orders and action items in Vantaca or designated systems.

Track completion and follow up on open tasks.

Coordinate move-in and move-out requests.

Address day-to-day operational issues impacting the property.

Key/fobs/clickers and entry systems request.



5. Compliance & Regulatory Tracking:



Support compliance efforts in all service areas by coordinating data collection, documentation, and delivery in partnership with the CAM and Compliance team.



Assist with statutory and jurisdictional requirements, including but not limited to:



Elevator certifications

Energy benchmarking

County registrations

Other jurisdiction-specific filings and inspections

Notify CAM of upcoming deadlines and compliance risks



6. Resale & Homeowner Support:



Assist the resale department by providing additional information and documentation as requested.

Coordinate with internal teams to ensure timely responses to resale-related inquiries.



7. Documentation & Systems Management:



File and maintain accurate records in SharePoint and Vantaca including:



Contracts

Compliance records

Correspondence

Inspection reports

Draft letters

Meeting notices, proxies, and related materials

Forms, service tickets,



Ensure documents are properly stored and accessible in Sharepoint and Vantaca.

Follow standardized folder structures, naming conventions, and document retention guidelines.



Authority & Escalation:



ACMs operate within defined approval limits and SOP guidelines.

Strategic decisions, policy changes, and board-level recommendations are escalated to the CAM.

Issues impacting association risk, budget variance, or legal exposure must be escalated promptly.



Performance Expectations & KPIs:



 and inquiry response time: < 2 business hours.

On-time utility payments and invoice processing.

Accuracy of GL coding and financial reporting.

Compliance deadlines met with no lapses.

SOP adherence and training completion.

Positive feedback from CAMs and boards on responsiveness and reliability.



Qualifications:

- Experience in the property management or real estate industry is required.

- At least 1 year of experience in HOA and/or condominium management is required.

- At least 2 years of remote work experience, demonstrating strong organizational and communication skills in a virtual environment.

- Familiarity using property management software (Vantaca or CINC is a strong plus).

- Experience using Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Outlook, Teams, etc.)

- Strong customer service experience.

- Strong ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment.



Working Hours: 9:00 am – 5:00 pm EST; Monday – Friday (US time zones)



Benefits: HMO and PTO after 90 days.

description:
ABOUT US



Metropole Laundry and Dry Cleaners and WeClean Philippines are looking for a resourceful, hands-on Marketing & Promotions Coordinator to take over marketing responsibilities currently handled by our agency.



Learn more about our brands and branches:



Metropole: 

WeClean: 



We operate multiple laundry branches in the Philippines. We need someone who can organize campaigns, coordinate with branch staff, create marketing materials, follow through on execution, and measure results.



Our main priority is offline marketing and branch promotions, supported by social media, local SEO, advertising, and customer retention campaigns.



We also want your ideas. You will be encouraged to identify opportunities and propose practical marketing initiatives for individual branches, based on their location, customers, competition, and performance.



PAY & WORK ARRANGEMENTS



• Rate: USD $3 per hour.

• Weekly hours and working schedule will be discussed.

• Please state your location and whether you can visit branches.

• Much of the coordination can be done remotely, but some activities require collaboration with local staff, suppliers, and creators.



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



Offline marketing and branch promotions



• Propose marketing ideas tailored to specific branches and their surrounding communities.

• Plan and coordinate voucher campaigns, seasonal promotions, referral programs, loyalty initiatives, and giveaways.

• Support promotions for new and underperforming branches.

• Prepare clear campaign instructions and follow up with branch staff.

• Coordinate flyers, posters, signage, stickers, calendars, laundry bags, and other promotional materials.

• Work with suppliers on quotations, production, quality, and delivery.

• Track voucher distribution, redemptions, campaign costs, leads, and resulting sales where data is available.

• Help develop partnerships with condominiums, residential communities, nearby businesses, and referral partners.

• Support the Sales team with B2B promotions and customer reactivation.



Social media and content creation



• Plan and manage content for
, Instagram, and TikTok.

• Write promotional copy and create basic graphics and short videos.

• Coordinate branch photos and footage with staff and creators.

• Promote specific branches, services, and offers.

• Monitor comments and inquiries and escalate customer service issues.

• Use trackable links and promotional codes to measure results.



Influencer and creator coordination



• Find relevant local micro-influencers and content creators.

• Coordinate outreach, fees, campaign briefs, branch visits, deadlines, and deliverables.

• Agree on content usage permissions.

• Track performance beyond views, including inquiries and promotional redemptions.

• Check that branches are ready before launching promotions.



Google Business Profiles, local SEO, and website



• Keep branch information, opening hours, photos, and links accurate.

• Coordinate genuine customer review requests and professional responses.

• Support local SEO, branch pages, and useful website content.

• Update website content and promotional pages, including Framer where applicable.

• Identify and resolve or coordinate fixes for website and booking issues.



Paid advertising



• Manage Meta Ads and Google Ads within approved budgets.

• Check conversion tracking before launching campaigns.

• Monitor spending, leads, bookings, and campaign performance.

• Test improvements and explain what is working and what needs to change.



CRM,
, and SMS marketing



• Organize customer and B2B lead records.

• Set up follow-up, retention, and reactivation campaigns.

• Coordinate lead collection with branches and the Sales team.

• Maintain appropriate consent records and unsubscribe handling.

• Track campaign results.



Reporting and organization



• Maintain a campaign tracker with owners, deadlines, budgets, and results.

• Provide weekly progress updates and monthly reports.

• Compare performance by brand and branch.

• Flag missing data, operational blockers, and underperforming campaigns.

• Keep company accounts, assets, and documentation organized.

• Present new campaign proposals with a clear objective, estimated budget, execution plan, and way to measure success.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



• Someone who takes ownership and follows through without constant reminders.

• Someone who brings practical ideas and can turn them into completed campaigns.

• Practical experience in marketing for businesses with physical locations.

• Strong organization and communication skills.

• Confidence coordinating branch staff, suppliers, creators, and sales teams.

• Ability to create basic marketing materials and work with spreadsheets.

• Clear written English and effective communication with Philippine teams and local partners.

• A practical approach to measuring results and solving problems.



Experience in laundry, dry cleaning, cleaning services, retail, hospitality, or other local service businesses is especially relevant.



We prefer someone who can handle most routine tasks independently. Additional support can be discussed when needed, but you should be able to identify the requirement and coordinate the work.



Please be honest about your skills. Tell us which responsibilities you have handled yourself, which you can manage independently, and where you would need support.



YOUR INITIAL PRIORITIES



• Collect the agency handover, account access, campaign files, and outstanding tasks.

• Review current branch promotions and identify execution or tracking gaps.

• Create a practical marketing calendar and branch follow-up process.

• Propose initiatives for priority branches.

• Launch or improve a measurable promotion for selected branches.

• Establish reliable reporting before expanding campaigns.

Metropole:

 address you used in the form and 2–3 brief marketing ideas you would propose for our branches.

title: Shopify E-Commerce & Paid Ads Specialist (Meta/TikTok) – Immediate Hiring
description:
# SHOPIFY E-COMMERCE & PAID ADS SPECIALIST — IMMEDIATE HIRING



**Company:** Zirinso | Smart Online Solutions LLC  

**Work Arrangement:** Remote — Philippines  

**Employment Type:** Part-Time, Long-Term Opportunity  

**Working Hours:** Initially 10–20 hours per week  

**Start Date:** ASAP



## ABOUT THE POSITION



Zirinso is hiring ONE experienced Shopify E-Commerce & Paid Ads Specialist to help us launch, manage, market, and grow our online business.



We are looking for a results-driven professional who can take ownership of day-to-day e-commerce operations, identify profitable product opportunities, and independently manage paid advertising campaigns designed to generate sales.



**Our priority is to start generating sales and build a profitable, sustainable e-commerce business.**



We are not looking for someone who only uploads products, designs websites, or posts on social media.



We need someone who understands the complete e-commerce process, from product research and supplier sourcing to customer acquisition, conversion optimization, and sales.



We value initiative, accountability, transparent communication, and measurable results.



**NO GATEKEEPING. NO UNNECESSARY DELAYS. WE ARE READY TO HIRE.**



## KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



### 1. Winning Product Research



- Identify trending and high-demand products with strong profit potential.

- Research competitors, customer demand, and market opportunities.

- Analyze pricing, competition, product costs, and expected margins.

- Recommend products based on research and commercial potential.

- Identify opportunities for branded products and product differentiation.



### 2. Supplier Research and Sourcing



- Find reliable suppliers and manufacturers.

- Compare product costs, shipping fees, fulfillment times, and quality.

- Evaluate suppliers for reliability and customer satisfaction.

- Recommend sourcing strategies that protect profit margins.

- Help establish efficient fulfillment processes.



### 3. Shopify Store Management



- Build, manage, and optimize our Shopify store.

- Create professional, conversion-focused product pages.

- Upload products, images, descriptions, variants, and pricing.

- Improve store navigation, mobile experience, and checkout.

- Manage relevant Shopify apps and integrations.

- Identify and resolve problems affecting the shopping experience.



### 4. Meta Advertising — MANDATORY



**Proven hands-on experience independently launching and managing paid
 and Instagram advertising campaigns is REQUIRED.**



Responsibilities include:



- Create, launch, and manage campaigns through Meta Ads Manager.

- Develop advertising strategies for e-commerce products.

- Research target audiences and competitors.

- Create or coordinate advertising videos, images, and copy.

- Set up or verify Meta Pixel and conversion tracking.

- Monitor advertising budgets and campaign performance.

- Analyze CPC, CTR, CPA, ROAS, and actual purchases.

- Test and optimize advertising creatives and audiences.

- Recommend when to improve, scale, or stop campaigns.



**Experience boosting posts alone does not qualify as paid advertising management experience.**



### 5. TikTok Marketing and Advertising



- Research trending products and advertising opportunities.

- Create or coordinate short-form product videos.

- Develop TikTok marketing strategies.

- Launch and optimize TikTok advertising campaigns when appropriate.

- Analyze performance and recommend improvements.



Hands-on experience with TikTok Ads Manager is strongly preferred.



### 6. Sales Growth and Conversion Optimization



- Develop practical strategies to increase store traffic and purchases.

- Improve product offers, landing pages, and conversion rates.

- Identify and address abandoned-cart and checkout problems.

- Recommend bundles, upsells, and promotional opportunities.

- Monitor advertising costs against product margins.

- Focus on measurable business performance rather than views and likes alone.



### 7. Communication, Reporting, and Accountability



- Provide regular updates on completed work and upcoming priorities.

- Submit weekly performance reports.

- Track advertising spending, traffic, sales, conversions, and profitability.

- Communicate challenges promptly and recommend solutions.

- Document processes, campaign settings, and supplier information.

- Work independently while keeping the business owner informed.



**Transparency is essential. All business accounts, advertising assets, creative files, supplier contacts, and campaign data must remain accessible to and under the control of Zirinso.**



## REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



- Proven Shopify e-commerce experience.

- Strong product research and supplier sourcing skills.

- Hands-on experience independently managing Meta Ads campaigns.

- Experience creating or coordinating advertising creatives.

- Understanding of e-commerce conversion tracking and sales funnels.

- Ability to interpret advertising performance and make improvements.

- Strong communication and problem-solving skills.

- Ability to work proactively with minimal supervision.

- Willingness to document work and share knowledge openly.

### Organic Social Media Marketing & Content Creation



- Manage and grow Zirinso's
, Instagram, and TikTok business pages organically.

- Create engaging product videos, Reels, TikToks, and social media posts.

- Develop a consistent posting schedule and content calendar.

- Research trending products, hashtags, and competitor content.

- Write engaging captions with strong calls to action.

- Build brand awareness, attract followers, and drive potential customers to our Shopify store.

- Repurpose successful organic content into paid advertising creatives.

- Track engagement, website traffic, and sales generated through organic marketing.



**Hands-on experience with organic social media marketing and content creation is required.**



## PREFERRED SKILLS



- TikTok Ads Manager experience.

- Experience with dropshipping, branded e-commerce, or print-on-demand.

- Canva, CapCut, or similar creative tools.

- Shopify Analytics and Google Analytics.

-
 marketing and abandoned-cart recovery.

- Experience advertising products to U.S. customers.



## WHO SHOULD NOT APPLY



Please do not apply if:



- Your advertising experience is limited to theory or basic training.

- You have never independently launched paid Meta campaigns.

- Your experience is limited to boosting posts or social media scheduling.

- You only specialize in data entry or product uploading.

- You cannot demonstrate relevant Shopify and advertising experience.

- You are unwilling to communicate transparently or document your work.



## IMMEDIATE HIRING — QUICK ONBOARDING



We are reviewing applications and conducting interviews immediately.



Our hiring process is designed to be straightforward:



**Step 1 — Application Review**



We review Shopify experience, paid advertising skills, and previous work.



**Step 2 — Short Interview**



Qualified applicants may be invited to a 15–20-minute video interview within 24 hours.



**Step 3 — Paid Practical Trial**



The preferred candidate will complete a short paid practical assignment involving product research, Shopify evaluation, and an advertising strategy.



**Step 4 — Immediate Onboarding**

title: Youtube Senior Editor
description:
Hey Editors! It’s Time to Level Up. Ready to Take Your Editing Career Further?



We are looking for an expert-level YouTube Video Editor who can create premium, retention-focused long-form content for top creators and brands. This role is best suited for editors who understand high-quality YouTube storytelling in the style of channels such as Vox, Johnny Harris, Cleo Abram, and other documentary/explainer-style creators. We are not looking for basic editors, short-form-only editors, or editors who simply add cuts and captions. We are looking for someone with strong creative judgment, technical skill, and the ability to turn raw footage and direction into a polished, engaging, and thoughtful YouTube video. The ideal editor understands pacing, story structure, audience retention, visual clarity, motion graphics, sound design, and how every editing choice affects the viewer’s experience.



Responsibilities



Edit high-quality long-form YouTube videos for creators, brands, and educational content.

Build strong hooks that make viewers want to keep watching.

Shape raw footage into a clear and engaging story.

Use B-roll, archival footage, graphics, music, sound design, and visual references intentionally.

Create clean motion graphics, maps, text animations, callouts, and visual explanations when needed.

Improve pacing, flow, clarity, and retention throughout the video.

Follow creative direction while also bringing your own strong editorial judgment.

Apply feedback quickly and professionally.

Work with creative leads, producers, and post-production teams to meet high creative standards.

Deliver polished edits on time in a fast-moving YouTube-first environment.



Qualifications



Strong experience editing long-form YouTube videos.

Expert-level skill in Adobe Premiere Pro.

Expert-level skill in Adobe After Effects and motion graphics.

Good understanding of Photoshop or other Adobe Creative Suite tools.

Strong storytelling and pacing instincts.

Ability to create documentary, explainer, talking-head, educational, or creator-style edits.

Strong use of B-roll, archival footage, visual references, graphics, sound design, and music.

Understanding of audience retention, viewer engagement, and YouTube performance.

Experience editing high-performing or high-quality content for creators, agencies, brands, or media companies.

Ability to work with feedback, revisions, and tight deadlines.

Strong attention to detail and clean technical execution.

Reliable computer/workstation setup and strong internet connection.



This Role Is Not For



Entry-level editors.

Editors with only short-form reel experience.

Editors with only wedding, corporate, event, or basic social media editing experience.

Editors who are not comfortable with long-form YouTube content.

Editors who only follow instructions but do not bring creative judgment.

Editors who cannot work with feedback or tight deadlines.

Editors who do not have strong Premiere Pro and After Effects skills.



Benefits



Work from anywhere! We’re a 100% remote team.

A quarterly wellness reimbursement

20 days of paid time off annually.

12 additional holidays per year.

Unlimited sick and bereavement leave.

Working for a company that is values-oriented and committed to positive social impact.

Unlimited reimbursement on book purchases for self-education.

Gifts/cash bonuses on birthdays, work anniversaries, and other work-related achievements.

Working directly with some of the largest brands on the planet.



Additionally, Dragonfruit is highly committed to offering all our team members opportunities for growth and mobility within the company. This could include moving up to Lead Short-Form or Long-Form Editor, Director of the Editing Department, Post-Production Supervisor, or even Creative Director or beyond! (Of course, all of these positions come with pay increases.)



If you’re ready to join Dragonfruit and play a role in shaping the future of YouTube, please apply using the link below.

We only accept applications submitted through this form:

title: Accounts Clerk- Sales and Receivables
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION: SALES & RECEIVABLES ACCOUNTS CLERK





Department: Finance

Location: Remote

Reports To: Finance Manager

________________________________________

POSITION SUMMARY

The Sales & Receivables Accounts Clerk is responsible for ensuring the accuracy, completeness, and timely recording of all sales and accounts receivable transactions across the Group's retail operations. The role supports daily sales reconciliation, customer account management, collections, receivable reporting, and revenue verification while maintaining accurate financial records and supporting documentation.

Working closely with Store Supervisors, Commercial Managers, the Finance Manager, and the Group Financial Controller (Remote CPA), the Sales & Receivables Accounts Clerk helps ensure that all sales transactions are properly recorded, customer balances are monitored, payments are accurately applied, and outstanding receivables are collected in a timely manner.

The role serves as the primary finance support for sales accounting and receivables administration while maintaining strong internal controls and audit-ready documentation.

________________________________________

POSITION OBJECTIVES

The Sales & Receivables Accounts Clerk will:

1. Ensure daily sales transactions are accurately recorded and reconciled. 

2. Maintain accurate customer accounts and receivable records. 

3. Monitor outstanding customer balances and collection activities. 

4. Support revenue verification and financial reporting. 

5. Ensure proper documentation of all customer payments. 

6. Assist with month-end receivable reconciliations. 

7. Maintain accurate audit trails for sales and receivable transactions. 

8. Support continuous improvement of receivable processes. 

________________________________________

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Daily Sales Reconciliation

Review and reconcile daily sales transactions from all retail outlets.

Responsibilities include:

• Verify daily sales reports against POS records. 

• Review Z Reports and sales summaries. 

• Reconcile cash, card, online payment, and bank transfer transactions. 

• Investigate sales discrepancies. 

• Coordinate with Store Supervisors regarding variances. 

• Maintain Daily Sales Reconciliation reports. 

• Escalate unresolved discrepancies to the Finance Manager. 

________________________________________

2. Accounts Receivable Administration

Maintain accurate customer receivable records.

Responsibilities include:

• Create and maintain customer accounts. 

• Record customer invoices. 

• Record credit sales. 

• Apply customer payments. 

• Process customer credits and adjustments after approval. 

• Update customer account balances. 

• Maintain complete customer documentation. 

________________________________________

3. Collections & Outstanding Accounts

Monitor customer payment performance.

Responsibilities include:

• Prepare Accounts Receivable Aging Reports. 

• Monitor overdue invoices. 

• Contact customers regarding outstanding balances. 

• Send payment reminders and statements. 

• Follow up on overdue accounts. 

• Escalate delinquent accounts to the Finance Manager. 

• Maintain collection activity records. 

________________________________________

4. Customer Payment Processing

Ensure customer payments are accurately recorded.

Responsibilities include:

• Verify payment supporting documents. 

• Record cash receipts. 

• Record bank deposits related to customer payments. 

• Match payments against invoices. 

• Investigate unapplied payments. 

• Prepare receipt summaries. 

• Maintain payment records. 

________________________________________

5. Sales Documentation Management

Maintain complete documentation supporting sales transactions.

Responsibilities include:

• File invoices. 

• Maintain credit sales documentation. 

• Maintain customer payment records. 

• File customer correspondence. 

• Maintain electronic and physical filing systems. 

• Ensure documentation is audit-ready. 

________________________________________

6. Revenue Verification Support

Support the Finance Manager and Group Financial Controller with revenue verification.

Responsibilities include:

• Compile sales reports. 

• Prepare reconciliation schedules. 

• Assist with revenue analysis. 

• Support variance investigations. 

• Gather supporting documentation. 

• Prepare schedules requested during financial reporting. 

________________________________________

7. Month-End Closing Support

Assist with month-end receivable and sales closing activities.

Responsibilities include:

• Reconcile customer balances. 

• Prepare receivable schedules. 

• Verify outstanding balances. 

• Support month-end journal documentation. 

• Assist with audit requests. 

• Ensure all sales documentation is complete before closing. 

________________________________________

8. Communication & Coordination

Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders.

Responsibilities include:

• Work closely with Store Supervisors. 

• Coordinate with Commercial Managers. 

• Respond to customer payment inquiries. 

• Support the Finance Manager with collection activities. 

• Provide timely updates on outstanding receivables. 

• Maintain professional communication with customers. 

________________________________________

9. Other Duties

Other duties and responsibilities that maybe assigned from time-to-time.

________________________________________

AUTHORITY LEVEL

May

• Request supporting sales documentation. 

• Follow up on customer payments. 

• Contact customers regarding outstanding invoices. 

• Prepare receivable reports. 

• Prepare reconciliation schedules. 

• Maintain customer records. 

• Investigate discrepancies. 

May Not

• Approve customer credit limits. 

• Approve credit notes. 

• Write off bad debts. 

• Approve refunds. 

• Approve discounts. 

• Modify accounting records without authorization. 

• Approve journal entries. 

________________________________________

KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)

Sales Accuracy

• 100% of daily sales reconciled accurately. 

• Sales discrepancies identified within one business day. 

Accounts Receivable

• Customer accounts updated accurately and on time. 

• Aging reports prepared according to schedule. 

• Customer payments applied within one business day. 

Collections

• Collection follow-ups completed within established timelines. 

• Reduction in overdue receivable balances. 

• Accurate documentation of collection activities. 

Administrative Accuracy

• Accurate filing and record maintenance. 

• Audit-ready receivable documentation. 

Reporting

• Timely preparation of receivable reports. 

• Accurate reconciliation schedules. 

Communication

• Prompt follow-up with customers and internal departments. 

• Professional customer service. 

________________________________________

QUALIFICATIONS

Required

• Certificate, Diploma, or Degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field. 

• Strong numerical and analytical skills. 

• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel. 

• Excellent attention to detail. 

• Strong organizational skills. 

Preferred

• Previous experience in Accounts Receivable or Sales Accounting. 

• Experience in retail accounting. 

• Experience with customer collections. 

• Familiarity with accounting software. 

________________________________________

SYSTEMS KNOWLEDGE

Preferred experience with:

• QuickBooks Online 

• Lightspeed POS 

• Microsoft Excel 

• Google Workspace 

Training will be provided where necessary.

________________________________________

PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES

The successful candidate should demonstrate:

• Integrity and confidentiality. 

• High attention to detail. 

• Strong analytical skills. 

• Professional communication. 

• Customer service orientation. 

• Reliability. 

• Time management. 

• Ability to work under deadlines. 

________________________________________

SUCCESS IN THIS ROLE

Success is demonstrated when:

• Daily sales are accurately reconciled. 

• Customer accounts remain accurate and up to date. 

• Outstanding receivables are actively monitored and collected. 

• Customer payments are applied promptly. 

• Financial records remain audit-ready. 

• Revenue discrepancies are identified and resolved quickly. 

• Month-end sales and receivable reporting is completed on schedule. 

• The Finance Department maintains strong cash flow through effective receivable management.

title: Automation Engineer - Dev - AI first - Strict TypeScript, Supabase, No Framework
description:

Your work:

title: Accounts Clerk- Payables
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION: ACCOUNTS PAYABLE & TREASURY OFFICER



Department: Finance

Location: Remote, Guyana

Reports To: Finance Manager



Works Closely With:

• Group Financial Controller (Remote CPA)

• Junior Accounts Clerk

• Procurement / Purchasing Team

• Warehouse & Inventory Team

• Commercial Managers

• Operations Team

• External Financial Advisor

• Local and Overseas Suppliers

POSITION SUMMARY

The Accounts Payable & Treasury Officer is responsible for managing the Group's supplier obligations, payment processes, treasury administration, expense management, petty cash controls, and banking support functions.

The role ensures that all supplier invoices, expenses, and payment obligations are accurately recorded, properly approved, and paid according to company policies and agreed payment terms.

The Accounts Payable & Treasury Officer serves as the primary point of contact for local and international suppliers and plays a key role in maintaining positive supplier relationships, managing cash disbursements, and supporting the Group's overall cash flow management.

The position supports multiple business entities across the Group and works closely with the Group Financial Controller (Remote CPA) to ensure financial records remain accurate and properly classified.

POSITION OBJECTIVES

The Accounts Payable & Treasury Officer will:

• Ensure all supplier invoices are processed accurately and timely

• Maintain accurate accounts payable records

• Coordinate local and overseas payments

• Manage petty cash controls and reconciliations

• Prepare weekly payment schedules

• Support cash flow planning

• Ensure expense transactions are properly recorded

• Maintain strong supplier relationships

• Support month-end and year-end financial processes

COMPANY STRUCTURE SUPPORTED

The role supports accounts payable activities across:

Gizmos & Gadgets Main Company

Business Units:

• Gizmos & Gadgets (2 outlets)

• Glamour Beauty (3 outlets)

• Shoe Heaven (2 outlets)

Green Trade Imports

• Distribution Operations

The Wine Vault

• Distribution Operations

• Retail Showroom

Glamour Duty Free

• Existing Duty Free Location

• Future Arrivals Duty Free

• Future Departures Duty Free

Gizmos Building

• Property Rental Operations

Memphis Holdings

• Holding Company Operations

Memphis Investments

• Investment Activities

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Accounts Payable Management

Manage all supplier obligations across the Group.

Responsibilities:

Receive, review, and process:

• Supplier invoices

• Credit notes

• Debit notes

• Supplier statements

Verify:

• Invoice accuracy

• Purchase approvals

• Supporting documentation

• Quantity and pricing consistency

• Correct company allocation

Maintain accurate supplier records.

Monitor supplier balances and outstanding obligations.

Ensure invoices are processed within established timelines.

Maintain complete audit trails for all transactions.

2. Supplier Reconciliations

Maintain accurate supplier account balances.

Responsibilities:

Perform regular reconciliations between:

• Supplier statements

• Company records

• Outstanding invoices

• Credit notes

Investigate discrepancies.

Resolve account issues promptly.

Ensure supplier balances are accurate at all times.

3. Payment Scheduling & Treasury Support

Coordinate the Group's payment process.

Responsibilities:

Prepare weekly payment schedules.

Identify:

• Due invoices

• Overdue invoices

• Priority payments

• Upcoming supplier obligations

Prepare payment recommendations for management review.

Coordinate payment scheduling according to:

• Cash flow availability

• Supplier terms

• Business priorities

Maintain payment tracking records.

Monitor payment status until completion.

4. Wire Transfer Preparation

Coordinate local and international payment requests.

Responsibilities:

Prepare wire transfer documentation.

Verify:

• Beneficiary information

• Banking instructions

• Supporting invoices

• Approval requirements

Prepare supporting schedules for management approval.

Coordinate with banking institutions where necessary.

Maintain records of all wire transactions.

Authority Restriction

May prepare payment documentation.

May not approve or execute payments.

All payments require management authorization.

5. Expense Management & Accounting Entry

Manage expense documentation and accounting entry.

Responsibilities:

Enter into QuickBooks Online:

• Supplier invoices

• Expense transactions

• Credit notes

• Vendor-related accounting records

Ensure:

• Proper supporting documentation exists

• Transactions are entered promptly

• Expenses are assigned to the correct entity

Submit entries for review by the Group Financial Controller.

Assist in correcting misclassified transactions when identified.

6. Petty Cash Management

Serve as custodian of company petty cash funds.

Responsibilities:

Maintain petty cash float.

Disburse petty cash according to company policy.

Verify:

• Approved petty cash requests

• Supporting receipts

• Proper documentation

Maintain:

• Petty cash log

• Supporting receipts

• Reimbursement schedules

Perform regular petty cash reconciliations.

Prepare replenishment requests for approval.

Immediately report shortages or discrepancies.

Internal Control Requirement

The Accounts Payable & Treasury Officer may maintain petty cash but may not approve petty cash replenishments.

All replenishments require management approval.

7. Cash Flow Support

Assist in maintaining visibility of upcoming cash requirements.

Responsibilities:

Provide information regarding:

• Supplier obligations

• Upcoming payments

• Large due invoices

• International payment requirements

Assist the Finance Manager and Group Financial Controller with cash flow planning.

Provide weekly updates regarding payable commitments.

8. Month-End Support

Support monthly closing activities.

Responsibilities:

Ensure all invoices are entered.

Prepare:

• Accounts payable schedules

• Supplier aging reports

• Outstanding invoice reports

Assist with:

• Accrual calculations

• Audit requests

• Financial statement preparation

Ensure month-end deadlines are achieved.

9. Supplier Relationship Management

Serve as the primary contact for supplier payment matters.

Responsibilities:

Communicate with:

• Local suppliers

• International suppliers

• Freight providers

• Service providers

Respond to supplier inquiries.

Provide payment status updates.

Resolve invoice-related issues professionally and promptly.

Maintain positive supplier relationships.

10. Internal Controls & Compliance

Support the Group's financial control environment.

Responsibilities:

Ensure compliance with:

• Finance SOPs

• Approval processes

• Documentation requirements

Maintain complete records for audit purposes.

Support reviews conducted by:

• Finance Manager

• Group Financial Controller

• External Financial Advisor

Recommend process improvements where appropriate.

11. Other duties and responsibilities that may be assigned from time-to-time

AUTHORITY LEVEL

May:

• Process supplier invoices

• Enter expenses into QuickBooks Online

• Maintain petty cash

• Prepare payment schedules

• Prepare wire transfer documentation

• Communicate with suppliers

• Maintain payable records

May Not:

• Approve supplier payments

• Execute bank transfers

• Approve wire transfers

• Approve invoices

• Approve petty cash replenishments

• Modify accounting policies

• Approve payroll

KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIS)

Accounts Payable

• 100% of invoices processed accurately

• Supplier records maintained accurately

• No significant overdue supplier balances without management approval

Payment Scheduling

• Weekly payment schedules submitted on time

• Payment commitments accurately forecasted

Expense Entry

• Timely posting of supplier invoices and expenses

• Accurate coding and documentation

Petty Cash

• Petty cash reconciled and balanced

• Complete supporting documentation maintained

Supplier Relations

• Supplier inquiries addressed promptly

• Positive supplier relationships maintained

Compliance

• Full compliance with finance policies and procedures

• Audit-ready documentation maintained

QUALIFICATIONS

Required

• Diploma or Degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or related field

• Minimum 2 years experience in accounts payable, bookkeeping, or accounting support

• Strong numerical and analytical skills

• High attention to detail

Preferred

Experience with:

• Retail businesses

• Distribution businesses

• Multi-company accounting environments

• Import and international supplier payments

SYSTEMS KNOWLEDGE

Experience with:

• QuickBooks Online

• Microsoft Excel

• Google Workspace

Experience with Lightspeed POS is an advantage.

PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES

The successful candidate should demonstrate:

• Integrity and confidentiality

• Strong organizational skills

• Attention to detail

• Accountability

• Professional communication skills

• Ability to manage deadlines

• Strong follow-up skills

• Customer service mindset when dealing with suppliers

SUCCESS IN THIS ROLE

Success is demonstrated when:

• Supplier invoices are processed accurately and on time

• Weekly payment schedules are prepared and managed effectively

• Petty cash is controlled and fully reconciled

• Supplier relationships remain positive

• Expense transactions are recorded accurately

• The Finance Manager has clear visibility into upcoming obligations

• The Group Financial Controller receives reliable and complete accounts payable data

• The Finance Department operates efficiently and maintains strong financial controls

title: Transaction Coordinator - Real Estate
description:
# Real Estate Transaction Coordinator — Virtual Assistant

**Heart of Chicago Homes**



We’re hiring an organized, proactive Virtual Assistant / Transaction Coordinator to help manage our real estate transactions from contract through closing. This position includes administrative work, deadline tracking, document management, and regular phone communication with clients and transaction partners.



We need someone who takes ownership, follows through without repeated reminders, and keeps important details from falling through the cracks. Your role is to keep transactions moving while helping our clients feel informed, supported, and cared for.



## About Heart of Chicago Homes



Heart of Chicago Homes helps homeowners throughout the Chicago area navigate their selling options, whether that means a traditional listing, a cash sale, or working through a more complicated situation.



Our mission is simple: **relationships over transactions, every time.**



Behind every property is a person with their own circumstances, concerns, and goals. We take time to understand their situation, communicate honestly, and help them make informed decisions without pressure.



That commitment carries through the entire transaction. Every call, document request, and update is an opportunity to build trust and make the experience easier for our clients.



## The Purpose of This Role



The successful person in this role becomes the person who can answer:



- **Where does each transaction stand, and what needs to happen next?**

- **Are we on track to meet every contract deadline?**

- **Are all required documents, disclosures, and signatures complete?**

- **Have earnest money deposits been received and confirmed?**

- **Where do inspections, attorney review, financing, and appraisals stand?**

- **Which clients or transaction partners need a call or follow-up today?**

- **Are sellers receiving clear updates and prepared for their next steps?**

- **What outstanding items could delay or prevent closing?**

- **Are attorneys, lenders, title companies, and agents getting what they need?**

- **Are walkthroughs, property access, and closing appointments coordinated?**

- **Are commission statements and closing figures ready for management’s review?**

- **Are transaction files complete and organized before and after closing?**

- **What issues need immediate attention from management or the agent?**



You will not be expected to make every decision yourself. You will be expected to maintain accurate information, identify missing pieces, follow up consistently, and bring concerns to the appropriate person early.



## Key Responsibilities



### 1. Open and Organize Transaction Files



- Set up each new transaction using our established systems and checklists.

- Review incoming paperwork for missing information, signatures, initials
